However, during the meeting, Snivy and Emolga end up trying to break up a fight and crash into one of the trainers, causing the trainer to insult them. Iris gets angered and intends to teach the trainers a lesson.

eps.t: A Surface to Air Tag Battle Team!
eps.d: On the way to the Unova League, Ash & Co. are ambushed by two trainers who challenge Ash & Cilan to a tag battle. With Braviary and Drilbur against Unfezant and Pansage, things get a bit tense. After the battle, Cilan takes everyone fishing so that the trainers can battle across Earth, Sky and Ocean.

Heading to the Unova League, Ash & Co. enter the Village of the Dragons, where Iris grew up. Iris is eager to tell her friends about her journey so the group decide to stay there. However, when they meet up with a friend of Iris, they find out that two Zweilous she's raising are feuding. To make matters worse, one ends up evolving into Hydreigon and starts to cause a rampage in the village.

eps.t: Drayden Versus Iris: Past, Present, and Future!
eps.d: After seeing her calm down a Hydreigon, Drayden told Iris that he's willing to allow her to battle him again. Iris is really excited for the battle, in order to defeat Drayden, so she ends up going for a walk through Opelucid City. In doing so, she bumps into an old school friend who helps her prepare.

eps.t: Team Eevee and the Pokemon Rescue Squad!
eps.d: Heading towards to Unova League, Ash & Co. end up getting trapped in a mountainside by various rocks. However, they soon get rescued by a trainer called Virgil, who runs a Rescue Squad with his brother and father in order to protect the town with his team, Team Eevee. Travelling back with Virgil, they soon discover that a problem has occured at a nearby dam - it has started to freeze over.

The time has come. Ash & Co. have arrived in Higaki City for the Unova League. When there, they meet up with Stephan, Bianca, Trip and Virgil. All registering for the tournament, they soon find Kotetsu who has been camping to make sure he doesn't miss the tournament, only to find out that he forgot to register. After helping him register, the preliminary battles of 128 people begin.

The preliminaries of the Unova League continue and the battle between Ash and Trip is unbelievably tense. With Serperior constantly evading Pikachu's attacks, Ash soon finds that he may be out of the tournament earlier than he thought. Will Ash manage to get through Serperior's defences and win? In the other side of the Unova League, Kotetsu and Bianca start a battle.

The Unova League has reached a middle point with the qualifiers over and as such, it's time for a short break but as Ash & Co. return to the dorms, they soon learn that Axew has disappeared. While looking for Axew, Oshawott inadvertantly eats food meant for Trubbish and Garbodor, angering those Pokémon. It's up to Pikachu and Ash to try and calm the situation while looking for Axew.

It's time for the next round of the Unova League. Having participated in competitions before, it's time for the final battle between Ash and Stephan within the Unova League. With Stephan using Liepard, Zebstrika and Sawk, Ash faces a massive challenge.

It's time for the quarter finals of the Unova League and Ash is facing up against his friend Kotetsu. Ash gets a shock when Kotetsu sends out the massively powerful Hydreigon. With the battles now being 6 VS 6 battles in this round, Ash faces a bigger challenge than he has had so far in the league.

Ash's quarter final battle against Cameron continues. With Cameron's Riolu having just evolved, Ash faces a tougher challenge than he thought he would when his Snivy faints. Having to rely on Pikachu, who is tired after already defeating two Pokémon in the battle, Ash faces the battle of his Unova League career.

After placing in the Top 8 in the Unova League, Ash & Co. decide to return to Professor Juniper's laboratory Nuvema Town. On the way, they meet with a girl who is just starting on her journey, and decide to help After discussing with Professors Oak & Juniper, Ash decides that he should return to Kanto before decidign where to travel to next.

Heading towards the White Ruins to help Cedric Juniper with research into Reshiram, Ash & Co. meet up with the trainer, N. Upon conversing with him, they learn that N has some strong ideals and believes that you should not battle with Pokémon, merely become friends with them. However, Team Rocket soon appear, using their new strategies to easily take out the Pokémon.

eps.t: There's a New Gym Leader in Town!
eps.d: Having arrived in Aspertia City, Ash & co. find out a new gym has recently opened up there with a new Gym Leader, Cheren. With the Gym behind the trainer school, Ash & Co. help Cheren out with teaching the various kids there. However, when Axew gets lost, its cries for help spook the other Pokémon in the school and they run off. It's up to Cilan to find them.

Arriving in Floccesy Town, Ash & Co. are attacked by a group of Amoonguss, who appear to have strange looks in their eyes. They soon learn from the locals that the Pokémon have started to become more violent and that some suspicious people have been spotted around the area. Soon afterwards, Pikachu and Axew soon turn on Ash and Iris, teamed with some wild Pokémon.

Arriving in Floccesy Ranch, Ash & Co. learn of a girl who is looking after a ranch using her Ampharos to herd them. However, the Mareep have stopped listening to the Ampharos and its owner thinks they can solve this by teaching it Thunderpunch, which Iris helps with using Dragonite.

Team Plasma are continuing their plot to control various Pokémon and are transporting Pokémon to use in their experiment. N is on their tail and attempts to protect and rescue the Braviary they are transporting. However, in doing so he alerts Team Plasma to his presence who attack him. Taking it to the Pokémon Centre, N meets up with Ash & co.

Heading to Virbank City, Ash & Co. soon see smoke in the distance. Rushing to it, they soon learn of a trainer who is training his Relief Corps Pokémon, Watchog Frillish & Dewott, to handle disasters. Within the team, however, Watchog is wanting to do more than just keep watch for more problems. However, an accident soon occurs in Virbank Complex and causes the Pokémon to be trapped.

eps.t: The Fires of a Red-Hot Reunion!
eps.d: Heading towards the White Ruins, Ash & Co. come across a special Kanto Fair, a fair celebrating the region of Kanto and the various Pokémon that dwell there. Ash is excited to see all these attractions that remind him of home and ends up seeing a cheerful Charmander. Reminding him of his old friend, Ash calls Profesor Oak and requests that he sends over Charizard.

As they arrive in a new city, Ash & Co. quickly learn that Team Plasma are there and are using their technology to once again manipulate Pokémon. In doing so, the Pokémon Haxorus starts destroying the city. Iris protests at this, claiming there's no way a Dragon-type Pokémon can be bad.

eps.t: Secrets from Out of the Fog!
eps.d: After being injured by Team Plasma's attack, N falls unconscious and Anthea & Concordia appear and take N away to a lake where N starts to heal. Cautious about Ash's presnece, Anthea & Concordia explain that the area is a special place where Pokémon and humans come to be healed of their wounds. Giving the history of the area, Ash & Co learn of N's past and how he is connected with Team Plasma.

Having infiltrated Team Plasma's hideout, Meowth confronts Colress and tries to convince him to switch sides to use his skills to work for Team Rocket. Colress, however, is insistent that he can awaken Meowth's true powers using his machines and attempts it, with Jessie & James watching from afar.

eps.t: Ash and N: A Clash of Ideals!
eps.d: Arriving at the Dragonspiral Tower, Ash & Co. learn that Cedric Juniper has discovered the location of the White Ruins, where the Light Stone is found, which can be used to awaken Reshiram. When they enter the White Ruins and find the Light Stone, it becomes engulfed with light and N soon appears.

eps.t: Team Plasma and the Awakening Ceremony!
eps.d: Having got to the White Ruins, Team Plasma have started attacking the archeologists in the area while looking for the Light Stone, having captured Iris, Cilan, Looker and Cedric Juniper, with Team Rocket looking on with interest. Underground, N notes to Ash that he can no longer hear the voices of the Pokémon above, indicating that Colress has used his machine to control them and he and Ash start…

eps.t: What Lies Beyond Truth and Ideals!
eps.d: After continuing their onslaught in the White Ruins, Team Plasma's plan starts to take shape. With Athena & Concordia returning, being worried about N, they try to stop Team Plasma. However, their Pokémon soon succumb to Team Plasma's control.

eps.t: Farewell, Unova! Setting Sail for New Adventures!
eps.d: After the Team Plasma escapades, Ash decides to return to Kanto with Iris and Cilan wanting to go there to continue their quests to be Dragon Master and Pokémon Connoisseur respectively. Following Juniper's suggestion, Ash & Co. decide to take a ferry which goes through the Decolora Islands.

As they begin their travels through the Decolora Islands, the boat stops off at Honey Island, a place that is world famous for making the special Honeymitsu honey gathered by the Pokémon on the island, specifically Combee. As part of a lottery, Ash wins an All-You-Can-Eat buffet offering over 150 different kinds of treats.

eps.t: Cilan and the Case of the Purrloin Witness!
eps.d: Traveling to the next island in the Decolora Islands, Ash & Co. participate in a small tournament on the ship. After the tournament, a gem collector intends to show off her special gem collection, and her Purrloin seems jealous of one of the jewels. Another gem collector is onboard and continually asks the collector to sell him her special Liepard's Eye gem, but she refuses.

Ash & Co. have arrived on Scalchop Island where the ScalchopKing Playoff tournament is being held. However, when they get there, they learn they are early. With the area filled with trainers with Oshawott and Dewott and they learn that if they win, they receive a golden Scalchop and get teamed up with the female division winner.

As Ash & Co. head to the next island, they soon find a large area of fog start to envelope the ship. They learn that the next island they're heading to is an island where loads of giant Pokémon used to live. As they enter the island, they soon sense something and spot a giant Heatmor, which attacks them.

Having learned that Professor Oak is to be on a nearby island, Ash & Co. decide to stop by to help him with his research. On the island, they learn it is filled with the Pokémon, Rotom, and Professor Oak is on the island to fully research Rotom's special form changes. As they arrive in the area, they soon find three Rotom and try to see what electricity the Rotom enjoy.

While heading to the next island, Team Rocket concoct a plan to steal all the food from the ferry's store room. However, before they get a chance, various Water-type Pokémon appear and steal the food before them, taking it off the ferry. Ash & Co. hear the alarm and rush to help, only to find the getaway raft and watch the Pokémon get away with the food.

Arriving on Migration Island, Ash & Co. witness a massive amount of Metapod evolve into Butterfree and fly away, as is tradition on the island. However, as the Butterfree leave, Ash notices a wild Caterpie emerge, having not even evolved into Metapod yet. Remembering his own Butterfree, Ash decides to help the Caterpie to evolve so it can leave on time with its family.

eps.t: The Path That Leads to Goodbye!
eps.d: Arriving on Big Island, the biggest island in the Decolora Archipelago, Ash & Co. encounter the rare Pokémon, Dunsparce. Ash is eager to capture it and challenges it to a battle. During which, it uses its Screech attack which disorientates Ash, causing him to fall onto Iris' floral headdress, and while Pikachu tries to attack the Dunsparce, Axew inadvertently crashes into it causing Dunsparce to…

Continuing their travel across Big Island, Ash & Co. become witness to a rare event, the 1,000 year awakening of the Pokémon Jirachi, who only wakes for seven days. As Pikachu and Axew play with Jirachi, Ash decides to introduce itself but Jirachi, scared of humans, backs away and leaves.

As they reach the other end of Big Island, Ash & Co. rest at the Pokémon Center, however when Ash wakes up he finds that Cilan, Iris and Axew's face has been replaced with that of a Beheeyem. Rushing outside, he finds that everyone in town, both people and Pokémon, have had their face turned into a Beheeyem face.

As they reach the next island, Ash & Co. meet up with Alexa, a journalist from the Kalos region, and her Pokémon Gogoat and Helioptile which don't register on Ash's Pokédex. Alexa explains that she's in the Decolora Islands to research an article on the tradition of the island, the Harvest Festival.

Heading to the next island, Alexa informs Ash & Co. that there are rumours of a hidden treasure on a nearby uninhabited island. Ash & co. decide to investigate this to try and find the treasure, helping Alexa to solve the mystery she learned when doing a report years before.

eps.t: A Pokémon of a Different Color!
eps.d: Arriving on the next island, Ash & co. meet up with the Blackthorn City Gym Leader, Clair. Clair has come to the island in search of a very special Pokémon, a shiny Druddigon! However, while searching for it, she got separated from her Dragonite so Ash & Iris decide to help find it.

Arriving on the next island, Ash & co. learn that it's the time of the year for the Woodate's Comet showing, which only appears once every 10 years, so they go to the top of a mountain to observe it. It is said that when the comet passes, the Pokémon in the area start acting strangely.

As they're on a new island, Alexa starts to work on a new article which gives Ash a chance to learn about Gogoat, one of Alexa's Pokémon from the Kalos region. However, soon afterwards, a boy who lives in the island comes over to Gogoat and touches its horn. As Gogoat can read minds when interacting with his horn, he sees what the boy is thinking and runs off with him.

While waiting for the boat to take them to the next island, Ash & Co. decide to take a break and have a picnic. However, while the Pokémon are playing, Iris misunderstands the conflict and erroneously scolds Emolga, which makes Emolga fly off angry. However, when it lands, it finds itself by Team Rocket, and defeats them. This causes them to urge Emolga to join them, which it accepts.

When on the next island on their journey, Ash & co. meet up with Cilan's brothers, Chili and Cress and learn about a dojo breaker who has decided to set her sights on the Striaton City Gym. Having already defeated Chili and Cress, the "dojo breaker" has decided that she needs to beat Cilan which is why they are all on the island and challenges him, to which he accepts.

eps.t: Best Wishes Until We Meet Again!
eps.d: Ash & co. have boarded the finalboat on the stretch of their journey and start to approach Vermilion City. However, Team Rocket are nearby and have plots to steal every Pokémon on the boat before it reaches the Kanto region. With their plot, they manage to lift the boat out of the sea, causing turmoil. However, when they attempt to succeed with their plan, Porter tries to stop them, but Ash & Co.

Having parted ways with Iris and Cilan, Ash returns to Pallet Town with Alexa. Initially intending to go to Professor Oak's laboratory to see his Pokémon, Alexa convinces Ash to pay a visit to his mother first. After some time there, Ash gets restless and heads to Professor Oak's laboratory and starts to reflect on his journey through Unova and the Decolore Islands, and starts to think abotu…

eps.t: Kalos, Where Dreams and Adventures Begin!
eps.d: After the journey across the Decolore Islands with Alexa, Ash has decided to go to the Kalos region. Thrilled to see new Pokémon, Ash and Pikachu walk through Lumiose City. However, they encounter a Pokémon, who seems to have a similar appearance to Blaziken, but looks different.

Ash heads to Professor Sycamore's laboratory, where he discovers the professor is investigating a strange looking Garchomp. Team Rocket overhears the conversation and tries to steal Garchomp for themselves, which would lead to a possible disaster.

Ash has registered for the Kalos Pokémon League and decides to set off on his journey towards the first gym. On the journey, he meets the cute Pokémon Dedenne, which appears to want some fruit. When Ash offers it some fruit, however, a Fletchling appears and steals the fruit. Ash challenges the Fletchling with his new friend Froakie to try and stop it. Will he be able to?

While heading to Santalune City, Ash & Co. stop to feed their Pokémon when they find the Dedenne they previously encountered has been following them. Bonnie is happy to see it and tries to get it, when it suddenly attacks. Meanwhile, Serena has arrived in Lumiose City and is offered a Starter Pokémon by Professor Sycamore. However, once she decides, she decides she needs to go find Ash.

Finally arriving in Santalune City, Ash decides to rush to the Gym to battle Alexa's sister, Viola. When they arrive at the gym, they meet Alexa who introduces them to her sister. Ash is eager and immediately challenges her. Learning she's a Bug-type trainer, Ash ends up with a bigger challenge than he had thought when her Surskit freezes the battleground, causing Pikachu to stumble.

After his loss due to Viola's interesting battle techniques, Ash has started training with Viola's sister, Alexa. The training specific to withstanding the Gust move from Vivillon and Surskit's Ice Arena. After the training, it is time for Ash's Gym Battle rematch against Viola, but will his training have worked or will he be suffering another loss at the hands of this Gym Leader?

eps.t: Giving Chase at the Rhyhorn Race!
eps.d: Heading back towards Lumiose City, Ash & Co. arrive in a small village where a special competition takes place, the Rhyhorn Race. After learning that the competition is open to anybody, Ash decides to enter. Serena takes the opportunity, based on the training with her mother, to be Ash's coach in the race.

When they arrived at the next city, Serena informs Ash & Co. that there is a special Star Groomer in the city. This groomer has got an apprentice who is having some troubles; the Furfrou she has to groom doesn't approve of her, and just refuses to be groomed. However, when some new groomers come in, and offer to groom the group's Pokémon, things are not what they seem. Will Ash & Co.

Returning to Lumiose City, Ash & co. bump into Clemont & Bonnie's father, who inadvertently reveals to Ash and Serena that Clemont is the Lumiose City Gym Leader. However, they soon learn that a machine created by Clemont, the Citroid, which was to guard the gym, has instead taken over it.

About to set off to Cyllage City, Ash & Co. decide to stop by Professor Sycamore's laboratory. However, when they get there, they discover that Team Rocket have decided to kidnap him in order to get his research on Mega Evolution. Bonnie & Serena try to investigate and look for Sycamore, but end up captured themselves. Ash & Clemont try to follow, but find a very gluttonous Chespin.

Heading towards the next city, Ash & Co. stop off to have some food, but while eating, two Pancham suddenly appear and begin to eat all of the food. While they are trying to sort it out, Team Rocket appear and manage to capture everyone, and fly off.

While heading towards Cyllage City, Ash & Co. see a person who sells Pokémon escaping from Officer Jenny. This seller makes his money by capturing and selling the Pokémon, Vivillon, which has different appearances based upon where it was born. Ash & co. decide to help Jenny catch the seller. However, as they get on his trail, Ash finds a Scatterbug that the seller had discarded. Will Ash & co.

While heading towards Cyllage City, Ash & Co. meet a Pokémon trainer who challenges Ash to a battle. She challenges with the stipulation that if she wins, Ash has to spend time with her. In the battle, she uses the Fairy-type Pokémon, Sylveon...the first Fairy-type Pokémon that Ash has battled.

While heading towards Cyllage City, Ash & Co. get stuck in a storm and have to find shelter. Coming upon a large mansion, they find that nobody is in it, but some strange things start to happen in it such as things moving, lights turning on and off and doors slamming.

While resting on their journey, Clemont's Chespin gorges itself on all the treats that Serena has made, and it starts to show as Chespin gets fatter. Clemont is intent to help Chespin get back into shape, but when it loses in two battles that were intended as exercise, Clemont decides to create a machine to help Chespin get into shape. However, once it's complete, Chespin is nowhere to be found.

While resting on their journey, Bonnie accidentally switches her bag with the bag of another girl. Both girls keep a Pokémon in their bag, with Bonnie getting the girl's Pichu and the girl getting Dedenne. Ash & Co. decide to look for the girl who now has Dedenne in order to exchange the Pokémon back, but with only a vague description, the search may be tricky.

While on their travels, Ash decides that it's time to train his Froakie. During the training, they end up meeting a ninja trainer and his Pokémon Frogadier, the evolved form of Froakie. Ash challenges him to a battle, but ends up losing. Ash is eager to improve with Froakie and requests the trainer's help to teach Froakie Quick Attack, so the four of them start to train hard.

Arriving in Camphier Town, Ash & Co. soon discover a wild Snorlax asleep in the middle of town, snoring and thus causing issues to everyone in town. In order to wake the Snorlax, they need to find King Shabboneau and have him play the PokéFlute. However, the PokéFlute has been taken by the princess of Parfum Palace and she refuses.

As they travel towards Cyllage City, Team Rocket encounter a new adversary in Madame X and her partner Pokémon, Malamar. Madame X had managed to use her powers to brainwash Jessie and James into doing her bidding before Meowth managed to escape. However, without any allies in this region, Meowth must turn to Ash & Co. for help.

Heading towards Cyllage City, Ash & Co. meet up with the Santalune City Gym Leader, Viola who informs them about the Battle Chateau, where people go for some of the strongest Pokémon battles. While there, they meet the Gym Leader of the next city, Grant. Due to the amount of wins both Grant & Viola have at the Chateau, it is their time to battle eachother. Who will win?

eps.t: A PokéVision of Things to Come!
eps.d: Heading towards Cyllage City, Ash & Co. learn of the PokéVision videos, that promote the attractiveness of trainers and their Pokémon. After watching a special video from one of Kalos' idols and her Fennekin, Serena decides that it's time for her to begin one herself. With the help of Ash, Clemont and Bonnie, she starts to film her video, but things start to go wrong...

Ash & Co. have arrived at Ambrette Town and decide to head towards the special aquarium, where many Water-type Pokémon have been collected from around the world. Meeting the curator and his Clauncher, Ash & co. learn that he is hunting for a special shiny Magikarp. Ash & co. decide to help him find the special Magikarp, with Clemont creating a special machine to help.

Reuniting with Alexa, Ash & co. decide to visit the Fossil Laboratory in Ambrette Town, to help Alexa with a feature she is doing. While exploring the laboratories, one of the scientists shows them a recently revived Amaura and Aurorus, two very rare ancient Pokémon. After some time playing with the young Amaura, Ash & Co. go to take a break, which is when Team Rocket sneak in to steal Amaura.

Finally arriving in Cyllage City, Ash decides to rush to the Cyllage City Gym to challenge Grant to a match. Grant accepts and sends out Onix, to which Ash responds by sending Froakie. Having trained hard to work around Onix's Rock Tomb strategy that they saw previously.

eps.t: A Battle by Any Other Name!
eps.d: Heading towards Shalour City, Serena decides to treat everyone to hand-made PokéPuffs, a special confectionary made specifically for Pokémon. However, a Slurpuff and its trainer soon come by and test Serena's PokéPuffs and give them a mediocre rating, causing an argument between Serena and the trainer.

Heading towards Shalour City, Serena gives Bonnie a special hair decoration based on a flower. However, a Flabébé mistakes it for its own flower, which it had previously lost, and stays with Bonnie. Ash & co. decide to help Flabébé to find its flower, but this proves to be difficult when they learn that the flowers are no longer in bloom. Will Ash & Co. be able to help Flabébé find its flower?

Heading towards Shalour City, Ash & Co. enter a small town where they hear that the champion of the region, Diantha, is there to officiate and take part in an Exhibition Match to begin a tournament in the town. Ash is eager to meet Diantha and challenge her to a battle, but is blocked by her staff.

Heading towards Shalour City, Ash & Co. enter a town where they are quickly apprehended by Officer Jenny, who claims that three people known as Ash, Serena and Bonnie, who have a Pikachu and a Dedenne, have been caught out numerous times in the town dine-and-dashing, among other things. Ash & co.

Nearing Shalour City, Ash & Co. meet up with the trainer Korrina. On learning that she is the Gym Leader of Shalour City, Ash decides to challenge her to a battle, but soon learns that Korrina is on a quest with her Lucario. She is investigating Mega Evolution and is hunting for the ability to help her Lucario Mega Evolve into Mega Lucario. Will she find the means?

Having teamed up with Korrina, Ash & co. arrive in Geosenge Town in search of the Lucarionite, the Mega Stone Korrina needs to Mega Evolve her Lucario. Having learned that the Mega Stone is found within a nearby cave, they go to investigate. However, while there, they find Team Rocket beat them to it and got blasted off by a mysterious force in the cave.

Having found the Lucarionite in the cave, Korrina meets up with her grandfather, the Mega Evolution Guru Gurkinn. To test Lucario's new power as Mega Lucario, Korrina and Ash decide to battle. However, when Lucario's power is stronger than it can handle, it loses control of its Aura and starts getting more and more brutal.

Having been given a trial by Gurkinn in order to help Korrina's Lucario control its aura after Mega Evolving, Ash & Co. set off to the nearby mountains. However, Team Rocket have reached the mountains first and have decided to set up a trap. The trap causes a horde of Noibat to anger and attack Ash & Co., seperating them as they escape. Will tjhey be able to find eachother?

Following Gurkkin's advice, Ash & co. join Korrina on a trip to the Must Mountains to face a trainer who has experience with Mega Evolution. However, during the battle, Korrina's Mega Lucario loses control of its power again, causing it to lose.

Heading towards Shalour City, Ash & Co. encounter an Ursaring bullying various other Pokémon in a forest. However, as they go to stop it, a Hawlucha comes out of nowhere to defend the other Pokémon. Ash is impressed by the Hawlucha's attitude in using cool moves with the intent of making the battle look good, so decides to help it train to perfect the move, Flying Press.

Heading towards Shalour City, Ash & Co. enter Kalos Canyon, an area where various trainers come to participate in Sky Battles. Meeting a trainer and her Talonflame, Ash decides to enter the Sky Battle with his newly caught, Hawlucha. If Hawlucha wins against Talonflame, then Ash will be able to test out his Fletchling. Will Hawlucha win and will Fletchling get its chance to shine?

Traversing through Reflection Cave, Ash & co. are checking out the marvels of the cave's reflective structure when Pikachu is taken from Ash by a strange version of Ash. Ash instinctively follows his doppelganger and ends up in a mirror world, where Serena is determined, Clemont is athletic and Bonnie is very "lady-like", all the opposite of the friends he knows.

While training for the Shalour City Gym battle, Hawlucha and Froakie start to be at odds, and can't seem to work in sync, and end up fighting in the battle. Ash is eager to change this so suggest a special combo to train them and help them learn to work together.

As they near Shalour City, Ash & Co. learn of a Pokémon Summer Camp being held by Professor Sycamore. In this camp, the trainers compete with each other in various activities, and get scored based on it with the top trainers entering the special Hall of Fame.

It's the third day in the Pokémon Summer Camp and the task put forth is the PokéVision Production. Serena, a big fan of PokéVision, is eager to get started and show off her Pokémon, so starts grooming and cooking PokéPuffs. However, when they go out to find a spot to film, Serena doesn't notice a cliff-face and slides down. Ash tries to grab her but falls down as well.

The Pokémon Summer Camp competition is heating up with Ash & Tierno's teams having the exact same amount of points. The next challenge is PokéEnteering, where each team has to go to various locations and collect stamps, and the fastest time wins. Both teams go smoothly through the challenge, but soon a mysterious mist appears and Bonnie gets lost.

eps.t: Battling Into the Hall of Fame!
eps.d: The Pokémon Summer Camp competition is coming to a close with both Ash & Tierno's teams at the top of the rankings. For the final assessment, a special Team Battle is to be held. This is where the six trainers face off against eachother at the same time. Before the battle, they all head to the Pokémon Center to make sure their Pokémon are in top-form.

Finally arriving in Shalour City, Ash & co. meet up with their old friend, Korrina and her Lucario. While there, they had towards the Tower of Mastery where Ash challenges Korrina to a gym battle, despite not having mastered the techniques Tierno showed him. However, the night before the gym match, Team Rocket appear in the tower and steal a document dedicated to Mega Evolution. Will Ash & Co.

After struggling to practice his defence moves taught by Tierno, Ash rushingly has challenged Korrina to a gym battle, and the battle is about to begin. In a three on three battle, Ash uses his Pikachu, Hawlucha and Fletchinder against Korrina's Fighting-type Pokémon Mienfoo, Machoke and Lucario, but with Lucario comes Mega Evolution and Ash has unable to beat Korrina's Mega Lucario in battle.

Heading towards Coumarine City, Ash & Co. meet up with a pair of brothers, each with a Meowstic. Having both been on their journeys separately, they are now returning home but, when they finally meet after so long, there is tension between the two of them.

eps.t: The Clumsy Crier Quiets the Chaos!
eps.d: Heading towards Coumarine City, Ash & Co. meet a Nurse Joy whose Wigglytuff continually makes mistakes, drops things etc. When a Slaamence starts attacking the town, injuring numerous Pokémon, things get worse for the Nurse Joy as Wigglytuff continues to make mistakes due to it panicking. But, when the Salamence begins to attack Nurse Joy, Wigglytuff stands up to defend its trainer.
After a Pancham disrupts a television performance and steals Ash's hat and Clemont's glasses, Serena battles it with her Fennekin in an attempt to capture it and teach it manners.

Heading towards Coumarine City, Ash & Co. find the school where Clemont used to attend. As they tour the facility, the power starts to go out and as they go to investigate, a wild Luxio blocks their path. It turns out that this Luxio evolved from a Shiny that Clemont had befriended as a child. However, there's a tension between them after a misunderstanding when they were young.

While heading to Coumarine City, Ash & Co. decide to stop off in a forest to relax. With everyone relaxing in their own way, Bonnie decides to explore the nearby area with Dedenne. On exploring, she meets up with three kids who call themselves the Lapras Defense Corps due to the fact they are looking after an injured Lapras.

While heading to Coumarine City, a fight between Pancham and Chespin causes the gang to meet a new trainer. Like Serena, this trainer is working on participating in the Tripokalon. Excited, they both show eachother their performances until they get interrupted by Team Rocket who steal the Pokémon.

While heading to Coumarine City, Ash & co. encounter a shiny Hawlucha attacking a Snubbull. When they go to help out, they learn that the Pokémon were in fact rehearsing for a play. Not realising this, they interrupt and accidentally hurt the Gallade that is the lead.

eps.t: An Undersea Place to Call Home!
eps.d: While fishing in the Muraille Coast, Ash hooks a Skrelp who manages to poison Pikachu. Rushing for help, he finds a pair of marine archeologist who are willing to help Pikachu. While helping Pikachu, they tell Ash & co. that they are looking for a luxury liner which was said to sink around this area. Ash & co.

While heading to Coumarine City, Ash & co. meet up with their old friend Sanpei, saving him after an injury during training. They learn that Sanpei was attacked by a masked ninja when on a mission to deliver a scroll to a mansion. Deciding to help, Ash & Co. join Sanpei on his mission, but soon the masked ninja appears and challenges them for a battle.

While heading to Coumarine City, Ash & co. visit a ranch. There, they find Serena's mother, Grace, is also visiting. Grace wants Serena to continue to train to be a Rhyhorn Racer, but Serena recently found a new path as a Pokémon Performer. Serena has been hiding it from her mother, but eventually tells the truth.

While heading to Coumarine City, Ash & co. encounter the evil Malamar that took over a power plant earlier in their travels. Noting that it is planning something, both Ash & co. and Team Rocket are captured by it and unable to stop it. However, when Clemont, James and Meowth break free, they try to rescue the others but James' Inkay starts acting very strangely and gets out of control.

While heading to Coumarine City, Ash & co. encounter encounter a Goomy, a Pokémon that is considered to be the weakest Dragon-type. As the group start trying to help the Goomy, Team Rocket monopolise on the distraction and steal both Goomy and Pikachu. When Pikachu & Goomy work a way to escape from their clutches, Team Rocket make haste. Will they be able to get away?

While heading to Coumarine City, Ash & co. take a break for their Pokémon to relax. While there, Ash introduces his Pokémon to Goomy, but Goomy gets rather nervous, and when Dedenne approaches to help calm it, it gets even more frightened due to its Fairy-type.

Having finally made it to Coumarine City, Ash & co. soon learn of a lost Vanillite who is hiding in the Pokémon Center. Ash & co. go to find it to help out just to learn that the Vanillite has been kidnapped by Team Rocket. As they start to investigate, snow starts to fall in the city. Meeting with Ramos, the Gym Leader, Ash & co. set out to rescue Vanillite. Can they do it?

eps.t: The Green, Green Grass Types of Home!
eps.d: After the long trek to Coumarine City, Ash finally reaches the gym and challenges Ramos to a battle so that he can earn his fourth badge in the Kalos region. While Ramos uses Grass-type Pokémon, he really causes issues with Ash by using various different types of moves.

It's time for the annual festival in Coumarine City. After learning of the festival and how the exchange of present to your Pokémon under the vow tree causes your bond with your Pokémon to grow, Ash & Serena decide to go shopping. This is the first time Ash and Serena have been completely alone, without their Pokémon or their travelling partners, so Serena thinks it is akin to a date and starts…

After lots of time practicing, it is time for Serena's showcase debut. Serena is overly nervous for her debut but reassuring words from Shauna, that they're rivals from here on, gets her nerves under control and allows for her to be ready. When she enters, she finds that there are more opponents than she realises, including Shauna and Jessie.

Heading back towards Lumiose City, Ash and co encounter an injured Spoink. They learn that the Spoink lived nearby but its family have been attacked by a Grumpig who took over the place. Ash decides to help out the Spoink to stop the Grumpig, but they end up falling into a Team Rocket trap. However, Dedenne and Goomy manage to escape, only to find Grumpig waiting for them.

eps.t: The Future is Now, Thanks to Determination!
eps.d: Heading back towards Lumiose City, Ash and co reach the Kalos Power Plant and decide to go and visit it. When they approach, Pikachu, Luxio and Dedenne start acting strangely and head towards the plant. When they reach it they learn that Team Rocket have got a plot in the Power Plant where they are taking control of Electric-type Pokémon. Will Ash & Co.

eps.t: A Fork in the Road! A Parting of the Ways!
eps.d: After another failed attempt at getting Pikachu from Ash & co., Team Rocket end up getting separated. Jessie and Wobbuffet end up in a river and almost drown until she is saved by a mysterious doctor called White. Jessie and Wobbuffet quickly become enamoured with White and his Wobbuffet, causing Jessie to start to think whether or not she should quit Team Rocket and spend her life with White.

eps.t: Battling with Elegance and a Big Smile!
eps.d: While training for their next Showcase, Serena ends up going harsh on Fennekin and Pancham when training doesn't go right, still torn from the loss in her first. Feeling down, she leaves Ash and Bonnie for a while for some alone time. As she walks through the city, she meets a girl who randomly approaches her to talk, and they end up going shopping together before finally having a practice battle…

Having met up with their old friend, Tierno, Ash decides to challenge him to a practice battle to prepare for his upcoming Gym battle with Clemont. During the battle, however, Team Rocket appears and kidnap Tierno's Pokémon as well as Ash's Sliggoo. When Ash & Co. finally find Team Rocket, trouble starts to break out due to a fire, and it's up to Sliggoo to help sort the situation.

Finally back in Lumiose City, Ash, Serena and Bonnie meet up with Clemont once again. Ash and Clemont are eager to start their gym match, but as it begins, Officer Jenny arrives to arrest the Clembot. It seems a robot looking just like Clembot is being used around the city to commit crimes. Insisting on Clembot's innocence, it's up to Ash & co. to investigate and clear Clembot of all crimes.

It's finally time for the long awaited gym battle between Ash and Clemont. With both of the trainers having trained, they intend to fulfill their promise and fight their hardest, despite knowing eachother's strategies. With Clemont using Bunnelby, Luxray and Heliolisk, and Ash using Pikachu, Hawlucha and his newly evolved Goodra, the battle will be tense.

While still in Lumiose City, Ash & co. decide to visit Professor Sycamore in his lab. They are delighted to see that Sycamore has found a Garchompite, but before they can test it, Team Rocket have stolen the Key Stone, the Garchompite and his Garchomp. They chase after Team Rocket to try to retrieve everything, but Team Rocket try to Mega Evolve Garchomp and attack them.

Leaving Lumiose City, Ash & co. reach the home that his Goodra fled when it was attacked. Goodra is overjoyed to reunite with its old friends, but it is soon discovered that the wetlands are still the home of a massive fight over who will live in the region. As they learn this, a Florges starts to lead an attack on the area.

After saving the Pokémon from an attack by Florges, Goodra got hit by an attack from the side, injuring it. While looking after it, Ash & co. are ambushed and Pikachu and the other Pokémon are all taken by Team Rocket. Ash & Co. set off to rescue the Pokémon but learn that the whole thing is a Team Rocket plot, with them forcing Florges to do their bidding at the threat of its Floette offspring.

eps.t: So You're Having a Bad Day!
eps.d: During a battle with Team Rocket, Ash & co., get attacked by a wild Pangoro who has been disturbed by the commotion. During the fight, everyone gets separated causing Bonnie to end up lost with nobody except Meowth, and to top it off they have inadvertently been tied together by a vine. Having to work together, Bonnie and Meowth have to try and find their way back to their friends.

Lost in a forest on the way to Laverre City, Ash & co. find what is known as the Scary House, a house that is said to be haunted. An old man appears and offers them shelter ahead of a storm, but when things start going strange there, things seem to go haywire. It's up to Clemont to find out what's the cause: Is it a Pokémon or something far scarier?

Arriving at Laverre City, Ash hads to the gym quickly to challenge it to gain his sixth badge in the Kalos region. Upon arriving at the gym, Ash learns that it is closed while its Gym Leader, Valerie, holds a special fashion show in the city. While at the gym, Ash meets a new trainer who was also looking for a gym battle, but as they're both disappointed, they challenge eachother to a match.

It's time for Ash's 6th gym battle in the Kalos region. Ash is excited to battle for the badge but Valerie has got a tricky fighting style using her Fairy-type Pokémon. As Ash hasn't come in with a particular strategy to defeat this new type of Pokémon, the battle will be fierce indeed. Facing off with his Fletchinder against Sylveon and Spritzee, Ash faces his toughest challenge so far in Kalos.
After winning his sixth gym badge, the gang helps Sawyer find his lost notebook from Team Rocket where he reveals details of his past and challenges Ash to another battle.

While heading towards Dendemille Town, Hawlucha finds an egg left alone in a forest. Bringing it to Ash, the group decide to try and get it to hatch and when it does, a Noibat appears. Noibat instantly bonds with Ash and Pikachu, but on bonding with it, they learn that the Noibat has not learned how to fly, so Ash & Pikachu put it through training to teach it how. Will they get Noibat to fly?

While heading towards Dendemille Town, Ash & co. learn of a Pokémon Sky Relay. Ash is excited to enter and brings his Fletchinder, Hawlucha and newly obtained Noibat to pasrticipate. However, as Noibat is still so young, it's still having trouble mastering flying. Will Ash be able to help Noibate learn to fly and will he win the Sky Relay?

While heading towards Dendemille Town, Ash & co. find the Poké Ball Factory, a place that creates all the Poké Balls used around the world. When there, they get offered a guided tour of the facility, but during it they find out it is one of Team Rocket's traps. Having been duped out of handing over their Poké Balls for a maintenance check, with the Pokémon still inside them still.

It's finally time for Serena's second showcase. After the issues with her first one, Serena is determined not to fail. Meeting up with Miette for the first time in a long while, Serena is completely fired up to do her best. This time, the performance's theme is about making PokéPuffs, which is one of Serena's specialties, which allows for her to rapidly pass to the next round.

While visiting a hotel on their way to the next town, Ash & co. encounter a place where battles are held using Pokémon as gambling pieces. Ash is challenged to a battle by the head of the hotel, only to discover that he has to use Pikachu as a betting chip.

eps.t: A Festival Trade! A Festival Farewell?
eps.d: In the next town, Ash & co. learn of the Gourgeist festival where all people dress up in various Pokémon costumes. Team Rocket are around and are wanting to steal Pikachu, but when the nearby count bumps into them, he asks if Jessie would like to trade her Pumpkaboo with him, to top it off, Jessie's Pumpkaboo has fallen in love with the count's Pumpkaboo. Will Jessie and Pumpkaboo part ways?

Heading towards Anistar City, Ash & co. come across a snowy mountain. Wanting to take a shortcut, they rent two Mamoswine so that they can cross the mountain range, but on their journey they discover an Abomasnow who is looking after an ill Snover. Ash & co. decide to help out and hunt for herbs for the Snover, but Team Rocket have their eyes on the ill Snover. Will Ash & co.

Having taken shelter in the Pokémon Center during a long rain storm, the roof of the Pokémon Center soon breaks causing damage to all the equipment in the building. Clemont sets himself up to repair the machinery, but soon finds that he lacks the various parts to do it. In order to get the parts, he sends Chespin and Bunnelby out to get the parts, but things don't go as well as they'd hope...

On their way to Anistar City, Serena begins training for the next Pokémon Showcase, but during the training the twig in Braixen's tail breaks. Seeing how heartbroken Braixen is, Ash & co. go hunting for a new twig to replace the broken one, but when Braixen rejects each of the twigs, questions soon begin to arise about why the twig is so important to Braixen.

On their way to Anistar City, Ash & co. bump into their old friend Trevor. Trevor is aiming to be a Pokémon photo collector and tells them that there are stories that the Legendary Pokémon, Moltres, can be found in the nearby volcano. Ash & Pikachu are excited to see the Legendary Pokémon Moltres so decide to join Trevor in his quest.

On their way to Anistar City, at night Bonnie comes to the rescue of a wild Tyrunt. She decides to take care of it, despite how big it is, but learns that it is pampered so it'll be very tough. However, Team Rocket soon appear, wanting to take the Tyrunt. As Bonnie tries to protect the Tyrunt from them, she soon finds herself in deep trouble and the Tyrunt soon starts to glow.

On their way to Anistar City, Ash & co. get ambushed by Team Rocket in a forest. While they managed to thwart Team Rocket, they ended up stuck in one of their classic pitfalls. While trying to work their way back up out of the ground, Bonnie notes that something similar has happened to her and Clemont before. That was the time that they met Bunnelby...

eps.t: The Frocking Find in the Flowers!
eps.d: On their way to Anistar City, Serena is practicing for the next Pokémon Showcase and trying out new performances. While doing so, they spot an Eevee dancing in the flowers. With the dance impressing Serena, she goes to befriend it but Eevee is reluctant, causing Serena to come up with an idea to befriend the Eevee. Will she be able to befriend it and create a new performance?

While heading towards Dendemille Town, Ash & co. meet an old man who is enamoured with the Pikachu species. As he's shooting a movie, he decides that Ash's Pikachu is perfect for the lead role. This makes Ash & co. all excited to see Pikachu working with the many Pikachu owned by the old man.

Practicing for the next Pokémon Showcase in Anistar City, Serena soon spots Shauna who is also entering the competition, and nearby Tierno who is there to support his friend. This gets Serena all fired up for the competition, but she starts to grow concerned. Her new Eevee is still very shy and Serena is concerned about how well it will perform in front of people.

It's time for the Anistar City Pokémon Showcase. With even tougher opponents than she has faced before, including Nini and Shauna, Serena faces a tough challenge. However, after she manages to get through the initial rounds and get to the theme performance. However, between rounds, Eevee gets lost and Serena goes to find it. Will she be able to find Eevee in time?

It's time for Ash's battle in the Anistar City Gym, but on the way there, Ash & Co. stop by the city's landmark symbol, the Anistar Sundial. When there, they see Professor Sycamore and are shocked when he is suddenly attacked by a mysterious woman.

It's time for Ash's battle in the Anistar City Gym, and this time it's different in that the Gym Leader, Olympia, is challenging him with a Double Battle. Using his Frogadier and Talonflame against the Psychic-type strengths of Olympia's two Meowstic, Ash quickly learns that Meowstic's Future Sight attack is far more powerful than he anticipated.
Bonnie makes a new friend, Ash runs into an old friend, and a terrifying premonition begins to unfold!
While Eevee deals with some unwanted attention, Team Rocket turns its attention to Squishy!

eps.t: A Giga Battle with Mega Results!
eps.d: There's trouble at the local Pokémon Center, but our heroes and Professor Sycamore are there to help!
As our heroes continue their journey to Snowbelle City, they encounter a young Pokémon faced with the challenges of growing up!

eps.t: Dream a Little Dream from Me!
eps.d: A nighttime campout brings some interesting adventures for our heroes' Pokémon!

eps.t: The Legend of the Ninja Hero!
eps.d: Our heroes' friend Sanpei is showing them Ninja Village, his home, but its peace and tranquility is soon to be threatened!
On the eve of the village festival, the fate of Ninja Village hangs in the balance!
Our heroes are in Couriway Town for Serena's next Pokémon Showcase, and her third Princess Key win is at stake!
Our heroes are visiting Terminus Cave with hopes of seeing new Pokémon, but they're not alone!
A courageous rescue during our heroes' search for Squishy leaves one of their friends in danger!
An expansive field of flowers provides our heroes with a beautiful setting to witness a blooming friendship!
Serena is invited to a dance party for Pokémon performers, and there are many surprises in store!
A fierce battle between two powerful Pokémon is about much more than just who wins!
As Team Flare continues to advance Operation Z, they get help from an unexpected source!
Traversing a vast expanse of parched land, our heroes discover a small group of dedicated individuals in need!
It's Pokémon Showcase time for Serena, and winning her third Princess Key is on the line!
Our heroes are about to take part in an exciting celebration, but the guest of honor is not happy!
Our heroes plan to visit a gem exhibition - but they run into a mystery instead!
The Pokémon Showcase Master Class is under way and Serena is competing with friends and rivals galore!

eps.t: Performing a Pathway to the Future!
eps.d: The Pokémon Showcase Master Class is in full swing and Serena's quest to become Kalos Queen is shifting into high gear!
Bonnie has been looking for someone to care for her big brother, but what will happen when she finds that someone?
Rock guitarist Jimmy and his Pikachu seek out Ash for a battle, but Ash is in bed with a fever and he needs his rest.
Clemont wonders about the mysterious change that sometimes happens to Ash and Greninja during battle, and he plans to get to the bottom of it with science.
Team Rocket finds some delicious macaroons in the forest and happily dig in, only to be attacked by a group of Phantump who think the treats are theirs.
Champion Diantha visits our heroes just as Ash and Greninja are doing some special training; Diantha challenges them to find out more about the bond they share in battle.
On their way to Snowbelle City, our heroes run into their friend Sawyer; Ash and Sawyer decide it's time for a battle.
Our heroes and Sawyer arrive in Snowbelle City; Ash is fired up to win his final badge at the freezing Gym.

eps.t: Seeing the Forest for the Trees!
eps.d: Ash's defeat at the Snowbelle Gym is followed some not-so-quiet introspection that turns into some real inspiration.

Having finally mastered Synchro with Greninja, it's time for Ash to have a rematch with Wulfric and earn his final Kalos Badge. Changing things up, Ash manages to get through until Wulfric shows a strategy he didn't see last time, with his Abomasnow Mega Evolving into Mega Abomasnow. With Abomasnow getting even more powerful, Ash faces an even bigger challenge than before.
The heroes confront an unusual group of challenges while visiting the home of friends.
Clemont invites the rest of our heroes to experience one of his true passions, while a certain group of uninvited guests are along for the ride.
The Kalos League is just getting under way and the battle temperature is already turned way up.

After the first round, the Kalos League contineus and this time, Tierno and Sawyer end up facing eachother. Sawyer has been studying Tierno's battle strategy, noting how rhthmically based it is since it is based on dancing. The battle is quite fierce. Who will get through and will Ash & Alain get through their battles?
The semifinals of the Kalos League bring two intense battles.
As Ash and Sawyer continue their semifinal battle, the audience witnesses a rivalry few have ever seen.

eps.t: Kalos League Passion with a Certain Flare!
eps.d: The final round of the Kalos League is about to begin and a lot going on behind the scenes.
During the Kalos League finals, Ash battles Alain in a much-anticipated battle.

The Kalos League Final continues and it is getting tense. With Alain just having Bisharp and Charizard left, Ash has the upper hand with Goodra, Pikachu and Greninja still in reserve. With Pikachu already worn out after taking out Tyranitar and Metagross, it may not last long. Who will emerge triumphant in this battle and become the Kalos League Champion?

The Kalos League is over and Team Flare have begun their onslaught, throwing Lumiose City into panic. Ash & Alain head to the Prism Tower to see who is behind it, but Team Flare appear in front of them with their eyes set on Ash. Lysandre also begins to explain his actions to the population of the city. Will Ash & Alain be able to save the city?

Team Flare's plan is coming to fruition. Ash has been captured by Lysandre and Squishy has transformed into its 50% Forme in order to try and help Z2. Serena, having bumped into Mairin, goes to help Mairin recover her Chespin from Team Flare while Bonnie goes to follow Squishy. However, Team Flare are still nearby and have their eyes set on Squishy. Will they be able to stop Team Flare?

eps.t: The Right Hero for the Right Job!
eps.d: The fate of Kalos depends on the outcome of Team Flare's plans; the team is doing its best.

Bonnie and Clemont have managed to stop the Zygarde rampage, and the Lumiose City Gym is liberated, but as the gang regroups to think the incident is over, the Megalith that Lysandre, Alain and Steven recovered in Hoenn starts to transform, and it even absorbs Mairin's Chespin. The Megalith soon starts to head off somewhere. Will Ash & Co. be able to stop it?

The Megalith is advancing and the entire world is at stake. With everyone helping open the way, it's up to Ash and Alain to get into the Megalith to rescue Mairin's Chespin. Stopping the Megalith isn't easy and all the gym leaders come to aid. However, soon after the fight begins, Squishy and Z2 work together and begin to transform into Complete Forme Zygarde.

Team Flare's plan has been thwarted by Ash & Co. and the Gym Leaders of the region, and it is time to rebuild as Lumiose City gradually returns to normal. Clemont works on rebuilding Clembot, but is disheartened to learn that it has no memories of the past. When a trainer returns to the gym for a rematch against Clembot, Clemont is unsure if it's a wise course of action due to the memory loss.

eps.t: The First Day of the Rest of Your Life!
eps.d: As Lumiose City is being rebuilt following Team Flare's antics, Serena decides to organise a Pokémon Showcase to cheer up the residents of the city. While doing the Showcase, she starts to feel something when she sees the joy she brings to the residents. Undecided on what to do next, with Ash returning to the Kanto Region, she soon inexplicably finds herself in a battle against Ash.

eps.t: Facing the Needs of the Many!
eps.d: Ash and the others came back at the wetlands and after saying goodbye to Goodra, they run into the plants that were raging wildly during the Team Flare incident, but manage to drive them back with help from Ash-Greninja. But then Team Flare scientist Xerosic returns and abducts Clemont.

The time has come. Ash, Serena, Clemont and Bonnie are going their separate ways after their journey through the Kalos region. Promising to meet again one day, as they go to board their flights, Dedenne runs away. As it is young, it doesn't want to say goodbye. Can Bonnie find Dedenne in time? In the interim, Clemont challenges Ash to one final battle to bring their journey full circle.

Ash, his mother, and Pikachu arrive in the Alola region on vacation to deliver a Pokémon egg to Professor Oak's cousin, Samson Oak. While exploring for new Pokémon, Ash stumbles upon a Pokémon school that Samson runs as its principal. While helping to defend the school from a group of Team Skull grunts, Ash witnesses one of the students, Kiawe, perform a powerful Z-Move with his Pokémon to drive…

On Ash's first day at Pokémon school, Professor Kukui and the other students host a surprise welcome party for him. Soon after Tapu Koko approaches Ash in order to battle Pikachu. Tapu Koko teaches Ash how to use the Z-Ring. Ash and Pikachu manage to unleash the Z-Move, Gigavolt Havoc, but the Z-Crystal shatters after Pikachu's immense release of power.

Professor Kukui gives Satoshi an intelligent Rotom Pokédex that is capable of human speech. Satoshi goes to find and catch his first Pokémon in Alola, but he instead encounters Rocket-Dan, who are aided by a wild Mimikkyu that despises Pikachu.

After Satoshi fails to capture two wild Pokémon, he encounters a Mokuroh that lives in a Tsutsukera nest. After Satoshi feeds the starving Mokuroh, it returns the favor by helping him fend off Rocket-Dan away from its nest. Afterwards, Satoshi catches Mokuroh as his first Pokémon in Alola.

Satoshi helps Suiren train her Ashimari to blow a water balloon large enough to enable undersea travel for people. During a school fishing trip, the class's Ride Pokémon are stolen by Rocket-Dan. However, Ashimari manages to blow a massive balloon to save all the Ride Pokémon from falling on the rocks.
Satoshi and Māmane are separated from their Pokémon during a visit to the local shopping mall.

eps.t: That's Why the Litten is a Scamp!
eps.d: Satoshi decides and fails to catch a stray Nyabby that continues to give him trouble.

Samson Oak has given the gang a task of looking after a special Pokémon Egg, but when it comes to night it was decided that the Egg should be kept at Lillie's house which makes Lillie uneasy as she doesn't like touching Pokémon. Ash goes with her and is shocked to see how big her house is.

As Rattata and Raticate cause trouble on the island, Ash decides to participate in the Island Trial Challenge. When meeting the Melemele Island Kahuna, Hala Ash says he is going to take on the trial, but Hala poses a question to him that Ash must answer before participating in it. Will Ash be able to answer the question and complete the trial?

After completing the only Island Trial on Melemele Island, Ash decides to face off against the Island Kahuna Hala in the Grand Trial. Hala uses powerful Fighting-type Pokémon and moves causing Ash some trouble as he currently only has Pikachu and Rowlet. During battle, Hala unleashes the All-Out Pumelling Z-Move causing Ash to retaliate with a Z-Move of his own. Will he be able to win the battle?

As the Pokémon School isn't in session, Ash is practicing his Z-Moves. As he is doing so, he sees Kiawe fly by on a Charizard. Kiawe mentinos that he is helping take care of his family's farm to do a delivery. Ash is intrigued and decides to go visit Kiawe's farm and meet his family. However, trouble soon arises when Team Skull show up...

eps.t: The Sun, the Scare, the Secret Lair!
eps.d: Everyone has gone to the Melemele Sea for an extracurricular lesson, but Team Rocket have also come to the area in search of new Pokémon. However, while hunting for Pokémon by fishing, they soon discover a mysterious new Pokémon, Mareanie, and one of the Mareanie takes a liking to James. Will James get his first Pokémon in Alola?

Continuing his studies in Alola, Ash soon learns from Mallow about a famous Pancake Race. Intrigued, Ash and all his classmates enter in the special pancake race but while there, he meets the champion from last year, a trainer and her Alolan Raichu. A rivalry soon sparks between Pikachu and the Raichu and the race gets heated.

The egg that Lillie has been taking care of has finally hatched into a Vulpix. Everyone is overjoyed at this but Lillie's excitement soon turns to depression as she cannot pet the Vulpix she took care of as an egg due to her fear of Pokémon. Due to this, Ash and co. decide to encourage her and try and get her to touch and bond with the Vulpix, but soon a shadow has its eyes on Lillie.

Rockruff has returned covered in scratches. Upon investigation, Ash & Kukui decide to record what Rockruff has been up to in order to find the situation. However, on looking at the footage, they see that Rockruff has been leaving the house every night to train so Ash decides to help it train up to become stronger. Will they succeed and find out why Rockruff has been training?

While Ash & Co. are playing on the beach, Popplio is making a bubble, but a gust of wind pushes Popplio and Rowlet into the bubble and they float away. When they land, they encounter the Litten that wanders around Melemele Island. It decides to take Popplio and Rowlet back to Ash, but Team Rocket soon arrive with plans of their own for Litten. Will they return to their trainers?

When he wakes up and heads to the Pokémon School, Ash soon finds that his Electirium Z that he earned has gone missing. Rotom, a huge fan of a crime show on Alolan TV, decides to search for the Electirium Z, wanting to act it out like the protagonist in that show. Will Rotom be able to find the Z-Crystal?

Mallow has come up with a new food item for the cafeteria, and Ash & co. all decide to ask Mallow to try it. However, the stew doesn't actually taste good and Mallow states that they need some Yellow Nectar in order to finish it, but the problem is that Yellow Nectar is hard to come by at the moment.

Ash has gone to visit Sophocles in order to learn the best way to try and defeat Tapu Koko in battle. Ash & Pikachu train with Sophocles in order to gain the upper hand, but soon afterwards Tapu Koko appears and challenges them. Will Ash be able to defeat the Guardian Diety of Melemele Island, or will he be defeated?

Hearing about Treasure Island from his classmates, Ash & Pikachu head to the island to explore. While there, it's the first time Ash & Pikachu have been out adventuring alone in a very long time and so they begin to strengthen their bond. However, before too long, a mysterious Pokémon appears overhead...

While shopping, Ash & Pikachu find Litten and learn that it at Stoutland have found a new place to live. However, later Ash finds Litten all worried and panicked and decides to follow Litten to help out. What has got Litten so worried? Is Stoutland ok?

While training, Ash discovers a mysterious shovel moving aronud in the sand. Learning that it's a Pokémon called Sandygast, Ash learns of the dangers in touching the shovel. However, Sandygast's shovel flies off and angers tha Sandygast. Will Ash be able to help it?

Ash and co. are attending a concert being held on Melemele Island and see a performance by DJ Leo and his Dugtrio. Going backstage, Ash starts getting to know the Dugtrio, but the Dugtrio starts fighting with itself putting in the possibility of splitting up. Soon after that, Team Rocket appear with their eyes set on Dugtrio. Will Dugtrio be saved and able to reconcile its differences?

It's time for an open day at the Pokémon School and Ash gets chosen to hold a presentation to all the people attending. Trying to work out what his presentation should be, he learns that his mother is coming to visit from Kanto, which causes Ash to be even more nervous. Rotom then comes up with an idea to help Ash. Will the presentation go off without an issue?

After seeing the power of Z-Moves while encountering Ash at the Pokémon School, Team Rocket decides to hunt for their own Z-Crystals so that they can keep level with Ash. In doing so, they encounter the Team Skull grunts who have been causing trouble on Melemele Island. In addition to that, while hunting for the stone, they discover the Totem Pokémon, Raticate.

Sophocles has overheard his parents seeking advice about moving and that means that Sophocles would have to leave the Pokémon School. Feeling down due to this, Ash & co. find out that he's moving and decide to throw a party for him. Will it cheer him up or is this an entirely big misunderstanding?

While at the schoo, Ash learns of a powerful trainer who has come to Melemele Island. Ash eagerly finds this trainer and challenges him to a battle. The battle is strong with the trainer's Z Move coming into full force but soon after the battle starts, Lillie appears and confirms that this trainer is her brother, Gladion. Why is Gladion here?

eps.t: Pulling Out the Pokémon Base Pepper!
eps.d: PokéBase is a famous sport in the Alola Region and, after watching a match on television, Ash decides that they should have a match at school. The match gets really heated, but then Team Rocket appear and join in. Who will win the match?

Ash and his classmates go on a camping trip in the forest. The trip does not start out well when Lana scares them all with a ghost story about a traveler who had all his energy drained from him while he was asleep. However, they have no idea that they are being spied on by a mysterious Pokémon. One by one, the gang except for Lillie is attacked, knocked out, and their energy drained from them.

As part of a class assignment, each of the students must take care of each other's Pokémon partner for the weekend. Pikachu gets to stay with Lillie at her mansion and Lillie is determined to try and overcome her fear of getting close to Pokémon, so she uses Satoshi's methods to gain Pikachu's trust.

Lychee, the Akala Island Kahuna, and her Lugarugan appear at the school just in time to stop a fight between Kaki's Lizardon and a Kentauros. She completely wins over everybody's Pokémon including Nyabby. The class and Professor Kukui will be traveling to Akala Island for a special practical class under Lychee's supervision. On the way, they encounter various types of Sea Pokémon.

As part of Lychee's practical lesson on Akala Island, the gang are sent on treasure hunts across the island mounted on Mooland, each of which reacts differently to its rider: Satoshi's Mooland is extremely friendly and enthusiastic, Suiren's Mooland does not seem to like her, and Lillie has trouble even getting close to her Mooland.

With no class today, Ash and Lana go Pokémon-fishing, but they may end up catching more than they bargained for since the lagoon they're fishing in may contain a water-type Totem Pokémon. If there is, then Lana is determined to battle it. Meanwhile, Kiawe takes the rest of the gang to visit his family's dairy farm, and Team Rocket doesn't seem to be having much luck with their own Pokémon-fishing.

Satoshi and his friends go to the Wela Volcano Festival, where an Alolan Garagara appears and takes the "Wela Crown", which supposedly has the power to make Pokémon stronger. Satoshi and Kaki chase after it, which leads to a fierce battle between Garagara and Kaki's Bakugames in which, even when using a Z-move, Bakugames is defeated.

Lychee and Professor Kukui send the class out to find ingredients for Akalan Curry in groups of two. The team of Satoshi and Mao find their task more challenging than expected, especially in getting past angry Karikiris, an Alolan Parasect and an Alolan Digda. Their search for the final ingredient brings them face-to-face with a Totem Rarantesu.

It's time for the Grand Trial on Akala Island. Ash has challenged Olivia and the battle is a Double Battle. With Ash using Rockruff and Rowlet, he soon finds that something is up with Rockruff and it's not acting right. Due to this, Olivia's Lycanroc and Nosepass put Ash into a tough position. Will Ash and Rockruff be able to push through?

Following the Grand Trial, Rockruff continues to get agitated and restless and decides to go out in the night. Not returning in the morning, Ash & co. start looking for it. Olivia suggests Ash check the Ruins of Life, where he eventually finds Rockruff. Learning it faced off against Tapu Lele, Rockruff is highly injured and, before they know it, it starts to evolve...

After another unsuccessful attempt to defeat Ash, Team Rocket are blasted off again. However, for the first time since they arrived in Alola, Bewear didn't protect them, causing Jessie and Mimikyu to end up in the shopping mall, causing Mimikyu's disguise to tear. With Mimikyu's true nature bringing terrible consequences, Jessie tries to provide alternatives, but Mimikyu is opposed.

With their cafeteria appearing on TV, Mallow ends up having a fight with her father and storming off into the forest. However, she soon finds herself injured and has to be protected by a wild Oranguru. However, Steenee has gone into the forest to look for Mallow only to find Team Rocket in pursuit. Will they be able to reunite?

Despite her recently obtained Z-Ring and Waterium Z, Lana is still having difficulty mastering Z-Moves. However, she soon meets a trainer with Popplio's evolution, Brionne, who has mastered the Water Z Move. Lana asks for their help and learns that they are around hunting for sunken treasure, and they start training together.

Charjabug Races are very popular in Alola and Sophocles is a huge fan. Wanting to enter with his Charjabug, Sophocles recruits Ash and Kiawe to team up with him to enter a race, but his Charjabug seems very docile and doesn't move fast in the car. Wih lots of training done, when the day of the race comes, it proves to be tough for Sophocles. Would he be able to win?

As part of an extra curricular class, the group travel to Kanto. When there, Ash meets up with his old friends Brock and Misty. Then, when takingthem through Oak's Laboratory to meet his old Pokémon, the group gets losts. To make matters worse, Team Rocket have also returned to Kanto briefly and have their eyes set on the Pokémon in the laboratory once again. Will they succeed?

Still in Kanto, the group heads to Cerulean City to teach the Alola group about Pokémon Gyms. Having had his last match at Cerulean Gym interrupted, Ash is eager to have a proper match as demonstration, and Kiawe also wants to battle. As such, battles soon begin of Ash VS Misty and Kiawe VS Brock, but when they start to use their Z-Moves, Brock & Misty pull out their trump cards: Mega Evolution.
One night, Ash has a dream and the next day, Ash finds the Pokemon he encountered in his dream and is determined to keep his promise.

eps.t: Now You See Them, Now You Don't!
eps.d: Looking after Nebby, Ash and his classmates realize that Nebby can teleport them to places, causing Ash and Pikachu to get lost.
Ash and his classmates visit Aether Paradise run by Lillie's mother Lusamine. Whilst there, a Ditto escapes and the gang have to find it among the other Pokémon.
Whilst giving his Pokémon a bath, Ash thinks about Gladion which results in Nebby teleporting him, Pikachu and Lycanroc to his location.
Ash's classmates attend a sleepover at Kukui's house where they are joined by Professor Burnet where Lillie starts thinking about her mother.

Having seen Gladion and Type: Null again, memories are starting to return to Lillie and have caused a relapse of her fear of touching Pokémon, being unable to touch Snowy. Lillie decides to travel around Alola with Ash & Nebby to revisit areas in order to get all her memories back.

With her memories awakened, Lillie has overcome her fears of touching Pokémon, so is enjoying hugging & playing with the various Pokémon at the Pokémon School. However, since her memories revealed Faba to have been at fault, Faba is now reacting and is plotting to kidnap Nebby and use it to open Ultra Wormholes to summon the Ultra Beasts. Will he be successful?

With Lusamine having been taken into Ultra Space by Nihilego, Nebby having evolved into Cosmoem and unable to move, and Lillie encountering her childhood fears, Lillie & Gladion decide to head to Poni Island in order to find a way to get through to Ultra Space to save their mother. Meanwhile, Ash consults with Hala after learning that Lillie has run away. Will he be able to help?

Ash & co. have come to the Altar of the Sunne in the hope of summoning Solgaleo to go to Ultra Space to rescue Lusamine. However, when they reach the altar, they find Tapu Koko, Tapu Lele, Tapu Bulu and Tapu Fini who seem to intend to help. After doing a ceremony, Nebby starts to glow once more and evolves into Solgaleo. Will it be able to help out?

Ash & co. have gone to Ultra Space on Solgaleo in order to find Lusamine, however to their surprise they find Lusamine has been enveloped by Nihilego and have to face off against her and the other Ultra Beasts, but with Lusamine's Pokémon strengthened by the Ultra Energy, they face a tougher battle than they had initially thought.

Ash has caught up to Lusamine with Solgaleo, but things are looking tense for his friends who are suffering at the hands of the Ultra Energy powered Pokémon owned by Lusamine. To top it off, with Lusamine having been fused with Nihilego, it's hard for Ash to rescue her as she attacks him. Lillie feels powerless to help her mother, but Ash soon discovers the ability to use a new move with Pikachu.

Ash & co. have returned to Alola from Ultra Space, having rescued Lusamine from the grasp of Nihilego. However, soon after, Solgaleo disappears and, when doing so, Kukui approaches Ash saying he has something important to tell him. Will Ash be able to find Solgaleo and what is Professor Kukui going to tell Ash?

Ash & co. have started to take great interest in Samson Oak's Komala. Learning that it's always asleep and that it can even eat and battle while asleep, the gang are curious over how it and Samson Oak met. However, before too long, Jigglypuff soon arrives in the school and battles with Komala. Will Komala be able to defeat Jigglypuff?

Rotom Dex is one of Ash's companions and is a Rotom in a Pokédex. After being hit by Pikachu's electricity, it is pushed out of the Pokédex and goes into Kukui's Washing Machine. It tries to go back to being in the Pokédex, but keeps failing and changes to all the different forms. Will Rotom be able to return to the Pokédex?

After a shopping trip, James' Mareanie encounters a Mareanie it used to have unrequieted love for. The other Mareanie proclaims its love for James' Mareanie, but James' Mareanie dismisses it as it likes James now. Due to this, James and the other Mareanie battle. Will James be able to keep Mareanie?

eps.t: Tasting the Bitter with the Sweet!
eps.d: Lana's sisters return from the forest, with a tale that they were saved by a large mysterious Pokémon. This brings memories back to Lana and Mallow of a time they were stuck in the forest and the Pokémon helped them. Thinking it was the same Pokémon, they go to the forest to thank it. Will they be able to find it?

eps.t: Getting a Jump on the Competition!
eps.d: Ash & Co. have gone to Mount Lanakila on Ula'ula Island. When there, they learn about PokéSled Jump, a sport where trainers and Pokémon ride on sleds together to go down the mountain. Everyone decides to enter the tournament, including Team Rocket and Hala. Who will win the competition?

As if from nowhere, an Ultra Wormhole opened and Ultra Beasts have started to pour through. Ash & co. are tasked by Lusamine to capture the Ultra Beasts and return them to their home world. Ash & Co. set off on their quest but it is harder than they thought it'd be. Will they manage to calm the Ultra Beasts?

After his ice cream gets eaten by Jessie, Meowth storms off in tears and meets an Alolan Meowth. Jessie & James start to think that Alolan Meowth would be a better fit for their group, and start hatching plans to get Pikachu with it. However, Meowth refuses to give up his position in Team Rocket so plans to get Alolan Meowth out of the group, but it seems the Alolan Meowth has plans of its own...

Ash & Co. have seen a Battle Royal on TV and gets excited when he hears that if you go to the venue, you have a chance to battle the legendary Battle Royal Master, the Masked Royal. In the first match, Ash loses when the Masked Royal's Incineroar defeats his Litten, so Ash gets determined and insists he'd win a rematch. How does the rematch go?

eps.t: Satoshi and Nagetukesaru! Touchdown of Friendship!!
eps.d: While out shopping, Ash encounters a group of Passimian. He learns that there has been a fight between the Passimian of Melemele Island and Akala Island over who will be the leader, and the Melemele Passimian lost. Ash wants to help the Passimian who lost, but when it doesn't work, he decides he must join them as a Passimian to help out. Will Ash be able to help them win?

A former graduate of the Pokémon School, a well known trainer called Ilima, has returned to the School. Many legends are said of this mysterious trainer and Ash & co. decide to spend some time with him to see if the legends about him are true. However, before too long Team Skull show up to cause mischief. Will the group and Ilima be able to stop them?

As part of their Pokémon School campaign, Ash & co. play Poké-Ping Pong, a game of Ping Pong with your Pokémon, taught by Ilima. While playing, they learn Ilima is a skilled player and is set to enter a tournament soon. Ash & Co. decide to go watch the tournament, but they soon learn that a player that defeated Ilima in a prior tournament will also be taking part. Will Ilima be able to win?

The mysterious Ultra Beast, Poipole, appears once again, seemingly attracted to Pikachu's electricty. At one point during the school day, while Ash is distrated, Poipole appears and takes Pikachu somewhere. What does Poipole want with Pikachu? When Team Rocket soon appear, trouble may be abound for both the Pokémon. Will they be able to protect themselves?

It's time for a special work experience project at the Pokémon Center. However, when Nurse Joy falls ill, Ash & Co. decide to look after the Pokémon Center in her absence by taking care of Pokémon, delivering medicine and various other tasks. However, things are tougher than they thought, especially when Team Skull show up with their injured Pokémon. Can Ash & Co. heal them?

Sophocles has found a massive piece of bamboo buried in the ground, but while unburying it, he finds a face which starts laughing. Thinking it's a character from a story he heard as a child, he requests everyone's help to dig it out. However, Team Rocket also have their eyes set on it. What is this Pokémon? Will Ash & Co. be able to protect it?

A strange man has appeared at Kiawe's family's farm stating he wants to buy it so he can build a new resort on the island. When they decline, the man starts harassing the family to try and take the farm against their will. Kiawe is angered and challenges the man to a battl but when he loses after Marowak fails with its Z-Move, things get rough. Will Kiawe be able to protect the farm?
