It's a time when the Pokémon, Dewpider, migrate to find a new place to live. However, for one, it's completely unable to find a new home. However, it soon crosses paths with Lana and falls in love with her, deciding to follow her to the Pokémon School. Will it be able to find a new home?

Mallow's older brother has returned home from a long journey. He is enthusiastic about taking part in the local Alola Bread Festival, held only once a year. Ash & co. decide to help him prepare for the festival, but when the day of the festival hits, catastrophe strikes. Will they be able to participate in the festival?

eps.t: Why Not Give Me a Z-Ring Sometime?
eps.d: As they got a Darkinium Z a while back, when James' Mareanie learns the move Knock Off, they realise they need a Z-Ring in order to activate the Z-Moves. Giovanni informs them they may be able to get one from the Kahuna of Ula'ula Island, Nanu, so they head straight to the island.

Wanting to continue his Island Trial Challenge, Ash has come to Ula'ula Island in order to face the Kahuna, Nanu. However, Nanu has avoided him so Acerola helps Ash track Nanu down, but Nanu refuses his challenge. Acerola decides to convince Nanu to let Ash battle him to show he's ready. Will Ash be able to prove his worth?

Following his defeat against Nanu, Acerola has taken Ash to the Ruins of Abundance to receive training from the Guardian Deity, Tapu Bulu. With the travelling having many obstacles, when Ash finally gets to Tapu Bulu, it doesn't seem to care. Will Ash be able to convince it to help him train?

Before taking his rematch against Nanu, Ash has to partake in the trial. However, the trial ends up being against Team Rocket. Once again after Pikachu, Team Rocket finally show their true power when they unleash Mimikyu's special Z-Move, Let's Snuggle Forever. With the Z-Move doing major damage, the battle between Pikachu and Mimikyu is fierce. Who will win?

It's time for Ash's rematch with Nanu to complete the Ula'ula Grand Trial. The challenge of this Grand Trial? Defeat all 3 of Nanu's Pokémon using only his Lycanroc. However, as the battle progresses, Lycanroc starts to get angry and stressed due to Nanu's Dark-type Pokémon. Will Ash be able to calm it and defeat Nanu?

Another Ultra Beast, Blacephalon, has appeared in Alola and so the group set off to calm it. However, soon afterwards, another Ultra Beast, Xurkitree also appears. The two Ultra Beasts start battling with their explosive attacks. How will Ash & co. be able to calm these Ultra Beasts and get them home?

Heading to Hokulani Observatory, Ash & Co. are on assignment to observe the Pokémon Minior. While there, they befriend one of the Pokémon and learn Sophocles once befriended one but can't really remember it. However, it seems this Minior has a secret...

Heading back from Mt. Hokulani, Ash & co. decide to take a shortcut through a cave. However, the group gets separated from eachother causing Lillie, Mallow and Sophocles to meet a group of Alolan Sandshrew. They learn that the Sandshrew are trying to protect their cave from a Tyranitar. Lillie decides to challenge the Tyranitar on behalf of Sandshrew. Will she be able to win?

Once again, Ash & Co. go to the Battle Royal Dome to see another Battle Royal. However, in the match, the Masked Royal seems to be in trouble when his Incineroar is in trouble due to dirty attacks. Ash's Torracat can't stand watching it and rushes into the ring. This causes Ash to join the Battle Royal as "Royal Ash". Can they get victory?

eps.t: All They Want to Do is Dance Dance!
eps.d: At the Pokémon school it was decided that the group will hold a PokéDance presentation where the Pokémon will participate in dances created by their trainers. All the trainers get in depth in making a dance that fits their Pokémon but when the day finally comes, Team Rocket appears and attacks, capturing all the Pokémon. Will Ash & Co. be able to get them back?

Aether Foundation member Faba has returned to the Pokémon School. He has come to show off a machine that will shrink anything, no matter how big. However, the machine malfunctions and Ash, Lillie & Sophocles get shrunk down and due to trouble, get stuck outside. Will Ash & Co. get back to the school and get back to full size?

eps.t: The Shape of Love to Come!
eps.d: Ash & co. meet Mina, a trainer who paints pictures. Together with her Ribombee, she's able to tell how Pokémon truly feel. On learning that Ash's Poipole likes to paint pictures, she takes a look and can sense great happiness but also sadness from the pictures. How does Poipole truly feel?

While at the Pokémon School with various athletic equipment, a Stakataka appears. The group immediately try to stop its rampage, but their Beast Balls won't hit it. As it's not moving, the group decide to leave it and regroup for the next day, but when they return it has started to move towards the city. Will Ash & Co. be able to stop it?

As they have been constantly having to assemble to take on the Ultra Beasts that appear in Alola, Ash & Co. are taken to a Pokémon Steam Paradise resort, where they also take their Ride Pokémon in order to get some rest. However, while relaxing, Team Rocket soon appear and kidnap various Pokémon. Will Ash & Co. be able to stop them?

The adults in Alola have started to act all lethargic and sleepy. To investigate this mystery, the Ultra Guardians head to the Altar of the Sunne to investigate, joined by Gladion. However, soon after they arrive an Ultra Wormhole opens up and Lunala exits, closely followed by the mysterious Ultra Beast, Necrozma. What does Necrozma want?

Lunala and Necrozma have appeared at the Altar of the Sunne and start battling. Ash & co. start to try to battle Necrozma to help Lunala but their attacks have no effect. However, to make things worse, a group from Team Rocket have also appeared and are trying to catch both Lunala and Necrozma. When all seems to be useless, Nebby returns from the Ultra Wormhole. What will happen?

eps.t: The Prism Between Light and Darkness!
eps.d: With Lunala recovered, Ash & Co. join it through the Ultra Wormhole in hunt of Necrozma who has taken over Solgaleo. When through the wormhole, they find themselves on Poipole's homeworld but things on this world are not alright. In addition to this, the special unit from Team Rocket is also going through the wormhole with their eyes set on Necrozma. Can they also be stopped?

With the strength of all of their Z-Moves combined, Ash, Lana, Kiawe & Gladion do their best to rescue Nebby and help Necrozma. However, back in Alola, Team Rocket are still trying to get into the wormhole to get Necrozma. Will Ash & Co. be able to help Necrozma return to being what is known in legend as The Blinding One and will they be able to save Poipole's world and Alola?

Ash & Kiawe have gone to the Pikachu Valley where many Pikachu live. When there, they meet a trainer who loves Pikachu. As the Pikachu come in many varieties in the valley, Ash's Pikachu is somewhat amused, but when Team Rocket show up, their Mimikyu starts going wild, and when its Z-Move is used, things get bad. Will Ash & Co. be able to protect the valley?

Ash & Professor Burnet have learned that the Masked Royal is going to hold a meet & greet on Melemele Island, they are eager to go and invite Professor Kukui with them. However, as Professor Kukui is the Masked Royal, he can't do that so he has to make a plan to get out of it, and when one of his rivals appears, things start to get messy. Will Kukui's plan succeed?

The Pokémon School is putting on a play and so the group and all their Pokémon are participating. However, everyone's family has been invited, including Ash's mother, which makes the group nervous. To make things worse, Team Rocket find the script to the play and barge in. Will the play work out?

Lana's sisters learn about haunted houses and decide that they want to go to one. However, with none in the region, the group decides to make one at the Pokémon School. However, when it's set up, a group of Ghost-type Pokémon soon appear and drag the group into a mystery world. Will they be able to return?

Some strange signals have started coming from Wela Volcano which are interfering with the process Lusamine uses to track the Ultra Wormholes so she sends the Ultra Guardians to Wela Volcano to investigate. However, instead of finding more Ultra Beasts, they instead find a group of Alolan Geodude & Graveler who appear to be taking food from the humans. Will they be able to solve the mystery?

As Burnet forgot to take her lunch to work at the Aether Paradise, Ash & Lillie decide to go there to deliver it. However, when there, they found Team Rocket have once again managed to get to the Aether Paradise with the nefarious plan to catch all the Pokémon being conserved there. To top it off, a Stufful from the Aether Paradise has gone missing. Will Ash & Co. be able to stop them?

Ash has decided to explore more of Melemele Island when he meets a trainer called Hau, who turns out to be the grandson of the Island Kahuna, Hala. He mentions that he and his partner Pokémon, Dartrix, are currently training for the Grand Trial and gets excited when he learns ash has already beaten it. After seeing Rowlet's evolved form, Ash challenges Hau to a battle. Who will win?

Ash & Co. have visited the set for Rotom's favourite Detective TV show. However, when Rotom notices a plothole, it barges onto the set during filming causing Ash to panic. However, when doing so, it catches the eye of the producer and Rotom is cast in the show. Will Rotom be able to follow through?

eps.t: We Know Where You're Going, Eevee!
eps.d: After a long voyage, Eevee has made it to Alola and befriended Pikachu and the various Pokémon. In an unusual area, it is full of energy exploring. However, when it is spotted by the local Alolan Persian, it starts getting chased and to make it worse, Team Skull spotted it and decided they want it to join them, causing Ash & co. to come to its rescue. Will they be able to save Eevee?

While training on Melemele Island, Ash once again encounters the Island Guardian Tapu Koko. Challenging it to a battle, its attacks clash with Pikachu's and create an Ultra Wormhole that drags Ash into a mysterious desolate world, one which has been destroyed and left in ruins. They discover that this is the world of the mysterious Ultra Beast, Guzzlord.

Having been sent into a mysterious world by accident when battling Tapu Koko, Ash finds himself in front of the Pokémon School, but this is not the world of the Pokémon School he attends. However, the mysterious trainer Ash has befrieneded continues his fight against the Ultra Beast, Guzzlord, who is responsible for all the destruction in this version of Hau'oli City.

Ash's old friends Brock & Misty have decided to come to Alola to visit. Ash & co. decide to show them all the great hotspots of the region including the pancake shop and even Mantine Surfing. However, with all the fun going on and time going quickly, Team Rocket soon show up with a plan to steal everyone's Pokémon. Will they succeed?

eps.t: Heart of Fire! Heart of Stone!
eps.d: Ash's old friends Brock & Misty are still in Alola and the group decide to go to Akala Island so Brock can meet the famous Rock-type Island Kahuna, Olivia. Brock is very excited to meet her, leaving Olivia a bit bewildered when they meet, but when she learns that he was a Rock-type Gym Leader, she challenges him to a battle. Who will win?

Ash & co. have gone to Poni Island to work on various research projects. However, Ash is eager to complete his Final Grand Trial and decides to look for the Kahuna, but upon learning there isn't one at the moment, he isn't sure what to do. Soon after that, a trainer named Hapu appears and attacks Ash, thinking Ash has stolen some fruit from the field.

Ash once again challenges Hapu to a battle but she gets angry and refuses. Soon after, Gladion appears on Poni Island and states he's there to meet Tapu Fini. As Lillie and Gladion talk, Gladion brings up their father. Soon after that, Ash challenges Gladion to a battle: Lycanroc VS Lycanroc. Who will win?

While at Poni Island, Sophocles decides he wants to evolve his Charjabug, so Hapu informs him that the electrical energy around Vast Poni Canyon will allow him to do so. Ash, Kiawe and Sophocles then head to the canyon where they find Horacio and his group who are in the canyon to do the same.

Ash is eager to battle Tapu Fini, the guardian deity of Poni Island, so rushes to the Ruins of Hope. However, when Tapu Fini doesn't appear, Ash & Kiawe decide to battle to pass the time and summon it. However, Tapu Fini is angered by this and traps Ash.

The Island Guardian of Poni Island has got a special power which lets people see loved ones that have long since passed from this world. When Mallow hears this, she gets really upset. As the group visit Hapu at her house, a mysterious mist soon comes from the Ruins of Hope. As they try to make their way through it, they all encounter someone important to them.

Following her standing up to Tapu Fini, Hapu has finally become the Island Kahuna of Poni Island. As he's there on the island to find the Kahuna, Ash challenges her to her Grand Trial. Her trial requires Ash to battle her with just one Pokémon. With Hapu using her Mudsdale, Ash faces a tough battle. Will he be able to win the Grand Trial and finish his research project?

eps.t: Keeping Your Eyes on the Ball!
eps.d: After their stint on Poni Island, Ash & co. meet the legendary golfer Kahili and her partner Pokémon, Toucannon. It's the first time that the group has seen the golf game and are fascinated so decide to take on the Poké Golf sport that's popular in Alola. With this version of Golf, both trainer and Pokémon must work together. Will they do well?

Some mysterious Pokémon have arrived in Alola, and these mysterious creatures eat metal! They start causing havoc across Alola by eating the tools at the Pokémon School, and even James' bottle cap collection. James is angered and decides to chase down the Pokémon to get his revenge. Just what are they?

Professor Oak has finished his research on the mysterious Pokémon Ash reported on and discovered it's the Mythical Pokémon, Meltan. One of the Meltan has grown attached to Ash's Rowlet and joins them all at the Pokémon School, but after an incident, its nut gets stolen. The group tries to replace it but it doesn't fit so Meltan and Rowlet head out to find its old nut.

Sophocles is going to be on a TV Show so Ash & Co. come to the TV station to show their support. However, when there, they see the filming of a series lead by a child-actor Magikarp. However, the Magikarp seems to have something off with it. With another TV show, the usual actresses don't show up in time which leads to Lana, Mallow & Lillie getting cast as replacements.

A new Ultra Beast has appeared from the Ultra Wormholes and has started attacking trainers. When attacking them, it ends up stealing their Z-Crystals. The Ultra Guardians are tasked with stopping this Ultra Beast, Pheromosa. However, Pheromosa also appears and steals Team Rocket's Z-Crystals, but while trying to stop it Meowth falls in love with Pheromosa.

After much planning, Professor Kukui has finally announced for the formation of the Pokémon League in Alola. However, while much of Alola celebrates, Team Skull's leader Guzma decides he has to destroy the plans and concept of the Pokémon League so marches to the Pokémon School to stop it. However, Ash immediately challenges him to a battle. Will Ash be able to win?

Since their trip to Poni Island made them realise that their father, Mohn, is still alive, Lillie and Gladion return to the Aether Paradise and investigate their father's old office. When there, Lillie discovers her father's old Z-Ring and the Mythical Pokémon, Magearna.

Ash & co. have gone to Malie City for a visit. The town is filled with Pokémon workin with humans to make the city a great place. While on a tour by a group of ninja guides, they get to see all the sights however Mallow's hair ornament ends up getting blown away. This causes Shaymin, Sandy and Meltan to chase after it and end up getting lost and fall into a trap of Team Rocket.

Still in Malie City, Ash & Co. arrive at the Pokémon Gym, based on the Gyms from the Kanto region. In this gym, the trainers battle you as you go up various floors until you reach the leader at the top. when they get to the top floor, they meet the trainer Ryuki and his Dragon Pokémon. Will they be able to defeat him?

A special Vikavolt race is being held and so Sophocles starts working on his capabilities with his Vikavolt so they can win. However, when the race begins, he learns that Horacio will also be participating with his Vikavolt which makes the situation even more tense. However, Team Rocket soon appear with a dark scheme to win as well.

eps.t: The One That Didn't Get Away!
eps.d: Ash & co. have gone to the seaside to fish for some Pokémon. However, while doing so, Ash and Lana get separated from the group in a whirlpool and stumble upon the Legendary Pokémon, Kyogre. Kyogre is under attack from some Pokémon hunters and ends up poisoned. It is up to Ash and Lana to help the Kyogre and save it from the hunters. Will they succeed?

Needing some mushrooms for the cafeteria, Mallow visits Oranguru's Pokémon café in the forest. However, when there she sees the café is unusually busy so she decides to help Oranguru out. Making lots of drink and food for the Pokémon, she is soon shocked when the Island Guardian Tapu Koko appears. What will she make for Tapu Koko?

Having previously told Giovanni that they had captured Bewear, Team Rocket are asked to send it back to HQ. Worrying about the consequences for lying, Team Rocket try their best to capture the Bewear that has been looking after them, but things get worse when Matori and the Alolan Meowth come from HQ to take Bewear back personally. Will Team Rocket's lie be exposed?

Now that everyone in the group has a Z-Move and a Z-Crystal, the group are practicing the moves. However, despite much practice Sophocles is unsuccessful in activating his, so he, Ash and Kiawe go camping in order to properly train to master the Z-Move.

All throughout Alola there have been reports of things getting cut randomly, and it turns out it's the Ultra Beast Kartana. The Ultra Guardians are dispatched in order to send it home. However, as the time for the Stufful Meteor Shower approaches, Deoxys and Rayquaza are out in space and are about to cause an effect on all of Alola. Are they able to stop it?

While training in a forest, Torrcat and Lycanroc's attacks collide. This disturbs the Mythical Pokémon, Celebi, who causes Ash to time travel back many years to where Ash meets a young trainer and his Litten. Back in the present, Professor Burnet finds and old photo of Kukui as a child with his own Litten, which causes Kukui to reminisce. Will Ash manage to get back to his own time?

After Ash & Torracat inadvertently got sent into the past by Celebi, Pikachu and the others are unaware and can't find Ash so decide to start searching for him. Their search takes them to the Pokémon School, Ultra Guardians base and even in the sky with Garchomp. What adventures await Pikachu and the other Pokémon, and will they be able to find Ash?

The group has gone to Lillie's house for training with their Z-Moves ahead of the Alola Pokémon League when Lillie shows the group the Magearna her father found for her. In addition to that, Gladion is on Melemele Island looking for something with hisUmbreon. Will he find what he's looking for and will Lillie finally master her Z-Move?

It's time for the opening of the Alola Pokémon League and the group have arrived at the stadium to register. The expectations for the league heat up as reveryone's rivals appear in quick succession. However, soon Guzma and the rest of Team Skull appear and start causing trouble, especially when Team Rocket also appear. This leads into a delve into the history of Guzma and Kukui.

It's the first round of the Alola Pokémon League, but unlike other leagues, the first round is a very unique battle. All 151 trainers entered into the league will battle with 1 Pokémon out at the same time. With many powerful trainers including Guzma and Ilima participating, the battle will be tough? Will Ash and his friends make it through to the Top 16?

It's the knock out rounds of the Alola Pokémon League to make the Top 16 come down to the Top 8. The battles are tense when it comes to Ash's Meltan VS Faba's Hypno, Ilima's Kangaskhan VS Guzma's Scizor, Hau's Raichu VS Samson Oak's Exeggutor but the big battle is between the two best friends of Lana and Mallow.

eps.t: The Battlefield of Truth and Love!
eps.d: With four of the knockout stage matches having been completed, the final four continue. The matches are Sophocles' Vikavolt gainst Mina's Ribombee, Kiawe's Marowak VS Acerola's Gengar, Jessies Wobbuffet VS James' Mareanie and Lillie's Vulpix VS Gladion's Umbreon. With Lillie and Gladion being a match between siblings, Lillie will go for her Z-move. Will it work out?

eps.t: Imitation is the Sincerest Form of Strategy!
eps.d: It's time for the Top 8 matches and for Ash, he comes against his friend Hau and his Decidueye. However, much to his friends concern, Ash decides he'll pick Rowlet for the match. However, when Rowlet's old friends Toucannon and Trumbeak arrive to cheer it on, they decide to help it learn the move Feather Dance. Will Ash be able to push through and help Rowlet learn the move ahead of the battle?

With Ash's Z-Move having not had any effect on Hau's Decidueye, Decidueye has come back with its Sinister Arrow Raid Z-Move, which Rowlet luckily managed to dodge. However, the battle continues on and, with Rowlet not having fully mastered Feather Dance, the battle gets even more tense. Will Rowlet be able to pull through and bring Ash to the semi finals?

The battle between Kiawe and Sophocles comes to a head with Sophocles unleashing Vikavolt's Z-Move against Charizard. With Sophocles having studied Kiawe's battle strategies intently, the battle is to be tense. In addition to that, the final Semi Final match between Lana and Guzma commences, with Guzma fully intent on winning the league so he can destroy it. Will Lana be able to stop him?

It's time for the semi finals of the Alola League and it starts off with the battle between Kiawe and Gladion. However, when Mimo, Kiawe's sister appears to cheer her brother on, she gets attacked by Team Skull and gets rescued by Gladion. With this, Mimo starts to worry about if her brother will bw able to beat Gladion. Will he manage it?

The semi finals match between Gladion and Kiawe rages on with Turtonator being against Silvally. With both trainers being so strong, who will win the battle? Afterwards, the semi final match between Ash & Guzma is set to begin, Ash is eager to win but Guzma is a strong trainer and is said to be undefeated. Will Ash be able to get through and defeat Guzma?

The semi finals match between Ash & Guzma continues. With Golisopod's Emergency Exit resulting in the loss of Scizor, Guzma is angry and with Ash showing remarkable strength and strategy, Guzma sees Kukui in him which makes him even more agitated. Will Ash manage to get the win against Guzma, a trainer who is said to be undefeated?

It's almost time for the finals of the Alola Pokémon League and, on the day before the finals, Ash's mother and Professor Oak arrive all the way from Kanto to cheer him on. However, soon after a group of Meltan appear and start doing something to Ash's Meltan. Gladion, Ash's opponent, is also preparing for the match being supported by his mother Lusamine and sister Lillie.

The battle to become Alola League champion is on. With both sides having lost their Legendary/Mythical Pokémon, Ash was stunned to see that the Lycanroc he was battling was actually a Zoroark. With Ash & Gladion both said to have a similar skill level, the battle rages on with a climatic finish of Lycanroc VS Lycanroc.

The Alola League Trophy Ceremony got interrupted by the opening of an Ultra Wormhole and the mysterious Ultra Beast Guzzlord coming through and starts devouring the League venue. Ash, the Island Kahunas, his friends and the Masked Royal all must band together to stop the Ultra Beast from destroying the world. However, this Guzzlord is not the only Ultra Beast comin through the Ultra Wormhole...

As Ash is the league champion of the Alola Region, the time has come for the special exhibition match. With his identity now revealed, Professor Kukui battles as him, not as the Masked Royal. With Kukui being not just the local Pokémon Professor but a trainer with many victories, the battle is to be tense. Will Ash manage to succeed in the battle?

The battle between Ash and Kukui rages on. With Ash being the Alola League Champion and Kukui being the Professor of the region known for his battling skill, the battle could go either way and with Kukui bringing in Pokémon from all around the world, Ash faces a tough challenge, especially when Kukui sends in Venusaur against Ash's Rowlet. Will Ash be able to push through?

The battle between Ash and Kukui rages on. With Ash using his untested Ultra Beast Naganadel, things can get very tough but the battle truly heats up when it features Incineroar versus Torracat once again. With these two having a rivalry, the battle gets incredibly heated. Which of the Pokémon will come out victorious?

With Professor Kukui down to his final Pokémon, the Island Guardian of Melemele Island, Tapu Koko, intervenes and requests to be Kukui's final Pokémon in order to battle Ash. Ash, with Naganadel and Pikachu remaining faces one of the toughest battles he has ever had. Will Ash manage to break through and defeat the Island Guardian?

eps.t: Dreaming of the Sun and Moon!
eps.d: With the League complete, everyone returns to their normal day to day life. As it's now time for vacation, Professor Kukui asks for everyone's plans over it, and when Ash learns of everyone's plans and dreams, he makes a decision. In addition to that, as they didn't get a chance to battle in the league, Ash and Kiawe decide to have one more battle. Which of them will win the battle?

eps.t: Thank You, Alola! The Journey Continues!
eps.d: Ash has made a decision to return to Kanto with a new goal of travelling more of the world to face stronger trainers. However, he has been struggling to tell everyone at the Pokémon school, but as he is trying to work out how to do it, Solgaleo appears in front of him.

In this prequel episode, Pikachu's backstory as a Pichu, his being cared for by a Kangaskhan after falling off a cliff, and Ash's backstory when he was 6 years old missing Professor Oak's camp because he overslept and breaking the Poké Ball Clock, the events leading to his evolution into a Pikachu and eventually meeting Ash are revealed.

Ash, his mother Delia, Mr. Mime, and Professor Oak travel to Vermilion City to attend the opening of Professor Cerise's new research lab. Professor Cerise wants Goh to choose the Kanto starters, but he refused because he wants to choose Mew instead.

A bunch of Ivysaur are causing chaos throughout Vermilion City, and Professor Cerise sends Ash and Goh to investigate. While learning the cause of the trouble, they not only learn more about each other but also clash with Team Rocket, who are now using Pokéballs supplied by Giovanni and delivered by a Pelipper that arrives whenever they call it.
Ash and Goh travel to the Galar Region to investigate reports that Pokemon are growing giant-sized, meeting up along the way with a mischievous Scorbunny that seems to connect with Goh.

Ash & Go have arrived at the Wild Area, a huge area filled with wild Pokémon. However, they soon come across a Snorlax which soon grows to massive sizes. As they came to learn about the Dynamax phenomenon, Ash & Go are excited by this. However, the Scorbunny they encountered in Wyndon has also come to the Wild Area in search of Go. Will they be able to meet again?

eps.t: Working My Way Back to Mew!
eps.d: After catching Scorbunny in Galar, Go noticed that his Pokédex got filled in when he caught it, which has caused him interest in getting every Pokémon. With Ash, he travels to the forests in the Kanto region and notices a lot of Bug-type Pokémon, so he sets himself a task: Catch every Bug Pokémon from Kanto. Which Pokémon will become his partners?

After catching many Pokémon in Kanto, Ash decides to take Go to the Hoenn region to participate in a special battle tournament. Ash is always eager to battle and is psyched but this is the first time Go has battled as he has just realised how fun catching Pokémon is. Using his newly captured Scyther and Scorbunny, battles are tense and Ash turns up to battle with the Mr.

At Vermilion City's port, Ash & Go find a worn out and disheartened Piplup. Taking it back to the laboratory, they're contacted by its Trainer who states that it swam there all the way from Sinnoh. Ash & Go decide to go to Sinnoh to escort Piplup back and learn of an Ice Floe Race. Will they enter?

Ash & Go have heard that the Legendary Pokémon, Ho-Oh, has been sighted in Ecruteak City in Johto so head straight to Johto to find it. When there, they see a Pokémon that resembles Ho-Oh instantly but soon learn it's a fake. They discover a local boy disguised one of his Pokémon as Ho-Oh to show his grandfather the Pokémon. However, with his plan failing, he hopes to find the real Ho-Oh.

Ash & Go have heard of a person who got rescued by Dragonite on the news. After hearing of their interest in Dragonite, Professor Sakuragi informs them of an area where Dragonite live. Ash & Go immediately go to search for it by sea. However, on the way they are hit by a storm and run aground on the island where Dragonite live. Will they meet the rare Dragonite?

Unlike Ash & Go, Koharu is very unenthusiastic about Pokémon. She gets on well with the Yamper but has no interest in capturing or battling with Pokémon. She is often labelled as someone who really loves Pokémon due to her father, Professor Sakuragi, a label which bothers her. Meanwhile, a Gengar starts to cause trouble in Sakuragi's Laboratory.

Ash & Go have gone back to Galar to watch the finals of the Pokémon World Championships, a competition that determines who is the best at Pokémon battles in the year. In the finals, Lance from Kanto and Leon from Galar face off. Ash & Go are excited waiting for the battle showcasing the Dynamax phenomenon.

eps.t: The Climb to Be the Very Best!
eps.d: Following the Pokémon World Championships final, a wild Drednaw has mysteriously Gigantamaxed in Wyndon Stadium. Ash and Go try to stop it but Pikachu starts getting surrounded by a red light... then, after that, Ash challenges Leon to a battle. With Ash using Pikachu and Leon using Charizard, the battle is fierce. Who will win? The Alola Champion or the World Champion?

The Ruins of the Titans have been discovered in the Desert Resort in Unova so Ash & Go head there to research the ruins. When they get there, they find numerous traps and eventually encounter an expedition team. With their help, they reach the end of the ruins and find a giant Golurk. Is this the titan of the ruins?

There are some issues at Sakuragi's laboratory. As such, Ash and Go have to return home while the systems are being fixed. Go is happy to see his parents as he hasn't seen them for a while but gets told they can't return home due to a job they have to do. Expecting as much, Go travels around town and meets a Cubone that is very sad.

Strange phenomenon have been happening at Sakuragi's Laboratory lately such as rooms getting ramsacked. On hunting down the problem, Ash & Go find out that the culprit is none other than the Gengar they had encountered previously. Ash & Go both intend to catch the Gengar but Ash starts acting very weird and even almost falls down the stairs. Is Gengar responsible? Will they stop Gengar?

eps.t: Kicking It From Here Into Tomorrow!
eps.d: As Pikachu & Scorbunny are practicing battles, Go's Darmanitan comes over to try and get Scorbunny to use a Fire-type move. Scorbunny tries to use Ember but it doesn't go well and it gers made fun of. Annoyed, Scorbunny starts practicing the move, with Go not wanting to help as Go feels Scorbunny can battle just fine with other moves. This causes friction and Go & Scorbunny start to fight...

Ash intended to battle the World Champion, Leon again, so he has entered the Pokémon World Championships. To qualify for the final few, he has to battle other trainers who are qualified. To start with, he will face Visquez, the deputy Gym Leader at Vermilion City Gym while Lt. Surge is away.

Team Rocket have gone to a movie set in order to get a movie role for Jessie. However, when there, a director gets mad at Ditto, a Pokémon that has a role in the movie, as it is struggling with its transforming. Ditto runs away from the set and ends up with Team Rocket who decide to help it become a skilled actor. Meanwhile, Ash & Go have been called upon in order to find the Ditto.

Professor Sakuragi is holding a Pokémon Orienteering event at his laboratory where kids will go through various spots to look for Pokémon. Ash and Go have both been chosen a leaders to guide the children around. Ash gets really focused on the battle part of the event while Go focuses on catching them, furthering their dreams. However, before too long Lugia appears.

Go has taken an interest in Pokémon eggs, as he has never seen one so he and Ash go searching for one. In their search, they come across an egg at the Pokémon Center. This egg has been passed from place to place without it hatching. However, Nurse Joy decides to entrust the egg to Ash. Will Ash be able to get the egg to hatch?

Ash & Go have head to Littleroot Town in Hoenn to investigate the Beautifly migration, which only happens once a year. During this, Go wants to get another Wurmple and calls to Raboot, but Raboot is disinterested. Later, Raboot sneaks out of the Pokémon Center. Where is it going?
All the food in the Sakuragi Park has disappeared, and all the Pokémon there are starting to fight out of hunger. Ash and Go decide to stake out the park overnight to catch the culprit.

Team Rocket receives orders from Giovanni to take a vacation, which apparently applies to all Team Rocket members, but while they're taking things easy in the Sinnoh Region Resort Area Matori and her Elite Team swoop in and start snatching up Pokémon!

Afterwards, Satoshi and Go revisit the place where Go had first met his Aceburn, leading them to reconnect with Aceburn's former friends. After a confrontation with Team Rocket, Go is summoned by Project Mew, forcing him to miss Satoshi's battle with Dande.

eps.t: Climax! The Night Before the Decisive Battle! Satoshi VS Dande!!
eps.d: The battles from the Masters Eight Tournament semifinals and the teams for Satoshi and Dande are reviewed.

Go travels to Hoenn for his next assignment for Project Mew. Meanwhile, Satoshi and Dande begin their full battle in the Masters Eight Tournament Finals, with Satoshi being allowed to use Mega Evolution, Z-moves and Daimax. In the battle, Gangar takes down Dande's Intereon, but Gangar is later knocked out by the opposing Barrikohru.

Satoshi and Dande continue their battle, with Satoshi's Mega Lucario defeating Barrikohru. As the battle goes on, Dande's strategy begins to tease Satoshi. After Mega Lucario is knocked out by Drapult, Kairyu avenges its teammate by finishing off Drapult with a Draco Meteor, giving Satoshi a 3–2 lead. For his next Pokémon, Dande brings out his Gorirander.

After Dande's Drapult is defeated, Dande gains some momentum and begins to turn the tables. Satoshi's Kairyu is taken down by the opposing Gorirander, who is then knocked out by Uonoragon. However, Uonoragon is beaten by Dande's Aceburn moments later. With just one Pokémon remaining, Satoshi sends in Pikachu to go up against Lizardon.

Satoshi and Dande have their Daimax Bands recharged by Mugendina, leading to a battle between Kyodaimax Aceburn and Kyodaimax Pikachu, which ends in Pikachu's favor. Pikachu then goes up against Dande's Lizardon and briefly passes out. However, Pikachu becomes motivated after imagining all of Satoshi's Pokémon cheering for him, allowing him to get back up and deliver one last Thunderbolt on…

The Project Mew team sets out for Faraway Island to commence their search for Mew. After being separated into two different groups, Shigeru and Tsurugi encounter a Groudon, while Go, Tokio, and Asahi come across a Kyogre.

eps.t: In the Palms of our Hands!
eps.d: The members of Project Mew are forced to confront Groudon and Kyogre. Mew reveals itself after disguising itself as the Hoenn Legendaries. Mew launches attacks at the Project Mew team until Go thanks it for inspiring him to set off on his journey. After the Project Mew team has achieved its goal, Go, Tokio, and Shigeru all go their separate ways.

Satoshi and Go return to Kanto and reveal their intentions on starting new adventures without each other. However, Go is unwilling to tell Satoshi his plan, as he doesn't want to betray his friendship with him. When Satoshi publicly announces his decision to continue his journey alone, Go becomes upset due to the feeling of betrayal.

eps.t: These Could be the Starts of Something Big!
eps.d: Following their Raid Battle with Lugia, Satoshi and Go go their separate ways and embark on their new journeys.
